text_en: There were no heavy traffic delays reported on the beltway, the city's alternate route.

text_en: Nigeria previously announced it planned to join the AfCFTA in the week leading up to the summit.

text: Komishina anoona nezvekutengeserana uye zvekugadzirwa kwezvinhu, vaAlbert Muchanga, vakazivisa kuti Benin yakanga iri kuzopindawo muchirongwa.
text_en: AU trade and industry commissioner Albert Muchanga announced Benin was to join.

text: Komishina akati "Hatisati tabvumirana zviga zvekunobviwa nemitengo, asi zvatagadzira parizvino zvakakwana kutanga kutengeserana musi wa1 Chikunguru 2020".
text_en: The commissioner said, "We haven't yet agreed on rules of origin and tariff con[c]essions, but the framework we have is enough to start trading on July 1, 2020".

text: Chitundumuseremusere chacho chakaramba chichifamba pamwero wekudenga wakafanana, kunyange zvazvo muchina wekuchinangidzisa wegyroscope wainge wafa nechekwekutanga chaiko kwerwendo, kutozosvika pakupera kwekufamba muchadenga..
text_en: The station maintained its attitude, despite the loss of a gyroscope earlier in the space station mission, until the end of the spacewalk.

text: Chiao naSharipov vakataura kuti mukaha wakanga uripo waisazokonzera ngozi.
text_en: Chiao and Sharipov reported being a safe distance from the attitude adjustment thrusters.

text: Mauto anotungamira pasi akamutsa majeti uye kukwirira kwakanaka kwepachiteshi kwakawanikwa zvakare.
text_en: Russian ground control activated the jets and normal attitude of the station was regained.

text: Nyaya yacho yakatongerwa muVirginia nekuti ndiwo musha veAOL inova shasha pakupa masaisai eindaneti, inova kambani yakakwidza nyaya.
text_en: The case was prosecuted in Virginia because it is the home to the leading internet service provider AOL, the company who instigated the charges.

text: Aka ndekekutanga kuva nemunhu anosungwa zvichibva pamutemo wakadzikwa muna 2003 unorambidza vanhu kuti vasatumira maimeyiri akawandisa kuvanhu vanenge vasina kumbokumbira kutumirwa.
text_en: This is the first time a conviction has been gained using the legislation enacted in 2003 to curb bulk e-mail, aka spam, from unsolicited distribution into users mailboxes.

text: Jesus uyo ane makore 21 akapinda muchikwata cheManchester City gore rapfuura muna January 2017 achibva kuchikwata chekuBrazil chinonzi Palmeiras, uye ari kunzi akatengwa nemapaundi anokwana 27 miriyoni.
text_en: 21-year-old Jesus joined Manchester City last year in January 2017 from Brazilian club Palmeiras for a reported fee of £27 million.

text: Kubvira ipapo, vanhu vekuBrazil vakatamba mumitambo 53 mumakwikwi ese aiitwa, uye vakagohwesa zvibodzwa 24.
text_en: Since then, the Brazilian has featured in 53 matches for the club in all competitions and has scored 24 goals.

text: Dr. Lee vakataurawo kunetseka kwavaiita pamusoro pemashoko ekuti vana vemuTurkey vava kubatwa neA (H5N1) vhairasi reavian furuwenza vasina kurwara.
text_en: Dr. Lee also expressed his concern about reports that children in Turkey have now become infected with the A(H5N1) avian influenza virus without becoming ill.

text: Dzimwe ongororo dzinoratidza kuti chirwere ichi chinofanira kuderera pamaurayiro achinoita chisati chapararira nyika dzese, akataura kudaro.
text_en: Some studies suggest that the disease must become less lethal before it can cause a global epidemic, he noted.

text: Pane kunetseka kuti varwere vanogona kuramba vachizadza vamwe vanhu vakawanda nekuramba vachiita mabasa avo emazuva ese sezvo zviratidzo zveflu zvichiramba zvakaderera.
text_en: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.

text: Leslie Aun, mumiririri weKomen Foundation, akataura kuti sangano rakaisa mutemo mutsva usingabvumire kuti rubatsiro kana mari zvipihwe kumasangano ari pasi pekuongororwa nevemutemo.
text_en: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

text: Mutemo waKomen wakamisa Planned Parenthood nekuda kwekuongorora kuri kuitwa mashandisiro anoita Planned Parenthood mari, uye kuongorora uku kuri kuitwa naCliff Stearns, anova nhengo muDare Reparamende.
text_en: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

text: Stearns ari kuongororawo kana mari dzemitero dziri kushandiswa kubvisa pamuviri nevePlanned Parenthood sezvo ari iye sachigaro weOversight and Investigations Subcommitttee, iyo iri pasi peHouse Energy and Commerce Committee.
text_en: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

text: Munhu aimbova gavhuna weMassachusetts ainzi Mitt Romney, akahwina musarudzo dzemutungamiriri wenyika, ari webato reFlorida Republican Party, nemusi weChipiri, uye akahwina nemavhoti anopfuura 46 muzana.
text_en: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

text: Aimbova Mutauriri weimba yeUS Newt Gingrich wakapinda pechipiri ane makumi matatu nemaviri kubva pazana.
text_en: Former U.S. Speaker of the House Newt Gingrich came in second with 32 percent.

text: Sezvo Florida ichiti munhu anenge ahwina musarudzo anotora zvigaro zvakawanda, yakabva yatsigira Romney yemavhoti makumi mashanu, zvichiita kuti akwanisewo kukwikwidza musarudzo dzekuva mutungamiriri wenyika.
text_en: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text: Varongi vekuratidzira vakati vanhu vangasvika zviuru zana vakaenda kumaguta eGermany akaita se Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, ne Hanover.
text_en: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

text: MuBerlin, mapurisa vakafungidzira kuti vakonzeri vemhirizhonga vaiva 6,500.
text_en: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

text_en: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text: MuLondon, vanhu vanenge 200 vakaratidzira kunze kwemahofisi makuru evane kodzero dzekuburitswa kwezvinhu.
text_en: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: Mwedzi wakapera, paiva nekuratidzira kwakakomba muPoland mushure mekunge nyika yasaina ACTA, izvo zvakakonzera kuti kuhurumende yePoland isarudze kusatsinhidza chibvumirano ichi, panguva ino.
text_en: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: Vese Latvia neSlovakia vadzosera kumashure chirongwa chekupinda muACTA.
text_en: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: Sangano Rerusungunuko rweMhuka ne sangano rehumambo rwoKudzivirira uTsinye kuMhuka (RSPCA) varikudana zvakare kufitira kwekumanikidza kwe makamera eCCTV munzvimbo dzose dzekuurayira mhuka dzemuAustralia.
text_en: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: Muongorori mukuru weRSPCA New South Wales, vaDavid O'Shannessy, vakaudza ABC kuti nzvimbo dzese dzinourayirwa mhuka, nyama yacho ichizotengeswa, dzinofanira kugara dzichiongororwa muAustralia.
text_en: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: "CCTV yaizonyatsoratidza vanhu vanochengeta mhuka kuti vakoshese kudzibata zvakanaka."
text_en: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: Mepu yepasi pose yekudengenyeka kwepasi yeUnited States Geological Survey haina kuratidza kudengenyeka kwakaitika muIceland vhiki range richangobva kupera racho.
text_en: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: Dhipatimendi rezvemamiriro ekunze reIceland rakataura kuti hapana kudengenyeka kwakaitika munharaunda yeHekla mumaawa 48 anga adarika.
text_en: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: Kudengenyeka kwenyika kukuru kwakakonzera kuchinja kwechimwe chikamu kwakaitika muna Kurume 10 neche kuchambembe kwakadziva kumabvazuva kwepamusorosoro pegomo rinoputika.
text_en: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: Makore matema asina hukama nemakomo anoputika akataurwa pazasi pegomo.
text_en: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: Sezvo kwaiva nemakore mudenga, zvanga zvava kunetsa kuziva kana paine gomo rakaputika.
text_en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: Chikepe cheLuno changa chakatakura mafuta  anosvika makubiti 120 000–160 000 pachakafa ndokutadza kufamba uye mhepo huru nemafungu zvakachisundira kuchidziro chinochengetedza kubva kumafungu.
text_en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: Zvikopokopo ndozvakashandiswa kununura vatyairi gumi nevaviri vengarava uye mumwe chete wavo ndiye akakuvara, akatyoka mhino.
text_en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: Zvakanzi zvichinjwe pabumbiro remutemo zvakanga zvatopfuura nemumatare emakurukota ese ari maviri muna 2011.
text_en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: Kuchinja kwakaitwa muchikamu chezvemitemo apo mutsara wechipiri wakabviswa pekutanga neImba yeVamiririri uye ndokuzopfuudzwa nenzira imwecheteyo musi weMuvhuro neSeneti.
text_en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: Kukundikana kwemutongo wechipiri, uyo unoda kurambidza kubatanidzwa kwevanhurume nevanhurume kana vanhukadzi nevanhukadzi, kunogona kuvhura suwo remibatanidzwa yevanhu mune ramangwana.
text_en: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: Zvichitevera mafambisirwo azvo, HJR-3 ichaongororwazve nedare rinotevera rinenge rasarudzwa muna 2015 kana kuti 2016 kuti irambe ichishanda.
text_en: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text_en: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text_en: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text_en: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text_en: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: Mutambi wekarati wekuJapan Hitoshi Saito, akawana nyembe dzegoridhe mbiri mumaOlympic, ashaya aine makore 54.
text_en: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: Zvakaziviswa kuti munhu wacho akafa nekenza yepanduru.
text_en: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: Akafira kuOsaka nemusi weChipiri.
text_en: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Paakafa, Saito, ainge ambohwina makwikwi eOlympic uye ari iye shasha yenyika yese uye akanga ari zvekare sachigaro wekomiti yekudzidzisa mutambo weJudo yeAll Japan Judo Federation.
text_en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Zviri nani kuti vanhu vanoda kusvika 100 vauya pamutambo, kuti vapemberere mhemberero yekutanga yevaviri avo vaive nemuchato vakaitwa gore rakapera.
text_en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Chiitiko chekupemberera chaicho chakarongerwa kuzoitwa pane rimwe zuva, vakuru-vakuru vakadaro.
text_en: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: Vaviri ava vaiva varoorana kuTexas gore rapera zvakare vakazouya kuBuffalo kuzopembera nehama neshamwari.
text_en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: Murume ane mhuri ane makore 30, uyo akazvarirwa muBuffalo, aive mumwe wevanhu 4 vakaurayiwa pakapfurwa vanhu, asi mudzimai wake haana kukuvara.
text_en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno mudzidzisi weChirungu anozivikanzwa zvikuru asi anokonzeresa mutauro akadzidzisa paModern Education uye King's Glory akapupura kuti aive nevadzidzi vanosvika 9,000 panguva yakusimukira zvakanyanya kwebasa rake.
text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Mune zvaakanyora akashandisa mashoko ayo vamwe vabereki vanoona seasina kunaka, uye anonzi aishandisa mashoko anonyadzisira mukirasi.
text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: Morden Education yaimupa mhosva yekugadzira mashoko ekushambadza achinamira pamabhazi asina mvumo uye achinyepa kuti ndiye aiva mukuru wevanodzidzisa Chirungu.
text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: Akambopomerwa mhosva yekukopa zvinhu zvaasina mvumo, asi hapana mutongo waakapiwa.
text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: Mumwe aimbove mudzidzi akati "aishandisa mutauro usina ruremekedzo paainge ari mukirasi, aidzidzisa unyanzvi hwekupfimbana mumanotsi ake, uye aingoita seshamwari yevadzidzi."
text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Mukati memakore makumi matatu apfuura, pasinei nekuramba iri nyika yechikomonisiti, China yakavamba hupfumi hwakavakirwa pakutengeserana.
text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: Chinjo dzekutanga mune zvehupfumi dzakaitwa pasi pehutongi hwaDeng Xiaoping.
text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Zvichibva panguva iyoyo, kukura kweChina pahupfumi kwakapetwa kanoita ka90.
text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Ndekekutanga kuti gore rapfuura China yakatengesa mota kune dzimwe nyika dzakawanda kupfuura dzakatengeswa neGermany uye yakapfuura United States pakugadzira mota dzakawanda.
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: GDP yeChina inogona kuwanda kupfuura yeUnited States mumakore makumi maviri.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Dutumupengo Danielle, rinova dutumupengo rechina raitika muna 2010 mumwaka wemaduti eAtlantic, ratanga nechekumabvazuva kwegungwa reAtlantic.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: Dutu racho, iro riri makiromita anenge 3000 kubva kuMiami, Florida, rine mhepo iri kumhanya makiromita anosvika 60 paawa.
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Masayendisiti ekuNational Hurricane Center ari kufungidzira kuti Danielle ichapedzisira yava dutu mupengo panozosvika Chitatu.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Sezvo dutu iri richiri kure chaizvo, hazvisati zvazivikanwa kuti rinogona kukonzera njodzi yakakura sei kuvagari vemuUnited States kana kuti vemuCaribbean.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Akaberekerwa muguta guru reCroatian, Zagreb, Bobek akaita mbiri paaitambira Partizan Belgrade.
text_en: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: Akavatambira kubva muna 1945 kusvika muna 1958.
text_en: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Munguva yake yenguva nechikwata, akarova zvibodzwa 403 mumitambo 468.
text_en: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Hakuna mumwe munhu akambowonekera kakawanda kana kupinza zvibodzwa zvechikwata kudarika Bobek.
text_en: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Muna 1995 akavhoterwa kuti ave ndiye shasha yevatambi vese vati vambotambira Partizan.
text_en: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: Mhemberero dzacho dzakatangwa nechikwata chinozivikanwa munyika dzese cheCirque du Soleil.
text_en: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Yakateverwa neIstanbul State Symphony Orchestra, bhendi reJanissary, uye vaimbi Fatih Erkoç naMüslüm Gürses.
text_en: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text_en: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text_en: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Chikwata chinoita zvekutamba cheFire of Anatolia ndicho chakazopedzisa nemutambo we "Troy".
text_en: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, ane makore gumi nematatu achiita mujaho hwemudhudhudhu, afa mushure mekumbondera paIndianapolis Speedway yemotokari.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Paakanga achigadzirira mutambo, Lenz akadonha pabhasikoro rake, uye akabva adhumwa nemumwe aikwikwidzana naye anonzi Xavier Zayat.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Akabva angotanga kubatsirwa nevashandi vezvokurapa vepamutambo ndokuzotakurwa kuenda kuchipatara chemunzvimbomo uko akazonoshayikira gare gare.
text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat haana kukuvara mutsaona iyi.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Zvichienderana mamiriro ezvemari pasi rose, Zapatero akaramba achitaura kuti "hurongwa hwemari chikamu chehupfumi, chinova chakakoshesesa.
text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: Gore rese tiine dambudziko remari, iro ranga rakanyanya kukurisisa mumwedzi miviri yapfuura, uye ndinofunga kuti izvozvi misika yezvemari iri kutanga kuvandudzika."
text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: Svondo rakapera, Naked News yakapa mushumo wekuti ichapamhidzira mitauro inoshandiswa pasi rese pakubuditsa nhau, nenhepfenyuro itsva nhatu.
text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: Iye zvino patova nemutauro weChirungu uye chiJapanese, uye sangano iri riri pasi rese riri kuda kutangawo mutauro weSpanish, Italian, neKorean, kuti mitauro iyi ibudiswewo paterevhizheni, paindaneti uye iwanikewo pamafoni.
text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: Ndine rombo rakanaka kuti hapana chakaitika kwandiri, asi ndakaona chiratidzo chakandityisa, vanhu vaiedza kupaza mafafitera kuitira kuti vabude.
text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: Vanhu vairova magirazi nemacheya asi mahwindo anga asingapwanyike.
text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: "Imwe simbi yakazodembuka, vanhu vakabva vatanga kubuda nepahwindo", akadaro mumwe akapona anonzi Franciszek Kowal.
text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: Nyeredzi dzinoita kuti pave nekujeka uye kupisa zvichikonzerwa nesimba rinovapo apo maatomu ehydrogen anobatana (kana kuti kusanganiswa) sechinhu chimwe kuti agadzire zvinhu zvine uremu.
text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Masaindisiti ari kuedza kugadzira muchina unogona kugadzira simba remagetsi nenzira imwe chete iyi.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Izvi, zvisinei, idambudziko rakakura kugadzirisa uye richatora makore mazhinji tisati taona mafusion reactor anoshandisika achizovakwa.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Tsono yesimbi inonyangarara pamusoro pemvura nekuda kwesimba remvura kuuya pamusoro.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Surface tension inoitika kana mamolecules emvura ari nechepamusoro akabatana zvakanyanya kupfuura mamolecules emhepo inenge iri pamusoro pawo.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Mamorekuru emvura anoumba kakanda kasingaoneki pamusoro pemvura ako kanoita kuti zvinhu zvakadai setsono zviyangarare pamusoro pemvura.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Chakaita banga pane zvekufambisa pamusoro pechando (skates), chine mativi maviri anopinza neyakaita semhango pakati pazvo. Aya mativi maviri anoita kuti zvive nyore kubata chando kana aizi, kunyangwe zvakateramiswa.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Sezvo kuzasi kwacho kwakatesveka zvishoma, simbi yacho painobhedha ichienda kune rimwe divi, kumupeto kwacho kunenge kuri muice kunobva kwabhendawo.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Ndizvo zvinobatsira pakuchinja kwaunenge uchida kunanga. Kana tusimbi twacho tukaenda kurudyi unobva wanangawo kurudyi, kana tukaenda kuruboshwe, unobva wanangawo kuruboshwe.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Kuti vadzokere pasimba ravo rekumashure vanofanira kubvisa simba rakawedzerwa rakabva pachiedza.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Anoita izvi nekubudisa kamwenje kadiki kanonzi ka "photon"
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Nyanzvi dzesainzi dzinodaidza kuita uku vachiti "kubatsiridzwa kubuda kweradiation" nekuti maatomu anobatsiridzwa nechiedza chakajeka, zvichisakisa kuburitswa kwephoton yechiedza, zvakare chiedza nderumwe rudzi rwe radiation.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Pikicha inotevera ndeyemaatomu anoburitsa mafotoni. Asi chaizvoizvo mafotoni madiki diki pane aya ari papikicha.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Mafotoni madiki diki pazvinhu zvese zvinonzi ndizvo zvinogadzira maatomu.
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Pashure pemazana emaawa ekushanda, chinhu chinojeka mugirobhu racho chinopedzisira chatsva uye girobhu racho rinobva ramirawo kushanda.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Girobhu rinenge rava kuda kuchinjwa. Zvakakosha kuti unge wakangwarira paunenge uchichinja girobhu.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Kutanga, chekubatidzisa mwenje chinoda kudzimwa kana tambo inofanirwa kusunungurwa.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Zvinokonzerwa nekuti magetsi anofamba mune chinoyereresa magetsi panogara chikamu chesimbi chepabharubhu chinokwanisa kukugwinha kana wabata mukati kana simbi yepasi pebharubhu kana richiri parinogara.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Mwoyo ndiwo nhengo yakakura yekufambiswa kwezvese mumuviri, zvakare ndiwo unopomba ropa.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Gazi rinobva mumoyo nemutsinga inotakura gazi rine okisijeni rozodzoswa netsinga inotakura gazi risina okisijeni. Twuchubhu twutetesa twunonzi tsinga diki.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Mazino etriceratops angadai akakwanisa kupwanya kwete mashizha cheteasi kunyange matavi akaomarara uye midzi.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Dzimwe nyanzvi dzeSainzi dzinofunga kuti maTriceratop akamedza macycad, urwu rudzi rwechirimwa chaive chichizikanwa zvikuru muCretaceous.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Izvi zvirimwa zvinoita kunge muchindwe mudiki unekorona inemashizha anocheka, anobaya.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Mhuka inonzi Triceratops inogona kunge yakashandisa muromo wayo wakaomarara pakubvisa mashizha emiti isati yadya hunde yemiti yacho.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Mamwe masaendisiti anoti miti iyi ine muchetura zvakanyanya saka madinosaur angangodaro aisatomboidya, kunyange zvazvo mazuva ano kapuka kanonzi sloth nedzimwe shiri dzakaita separrot (iyo yakabva kumadinosaur) dzinogona kudya mashizha kana michero ine muchetura.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Simba reJupiter rekukwevera zvinhu pasi ringandikweva kusvika papi? Kana ukamira paJupiter, waizorema zvishoma pane zvaunoita uri paNyika pano.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Munhu anorema 90kg pano panyika anogona kurema 16kg kudai aizoenda pamwedzi unotenderera Jupita unonzi lo. Saka simba regravity rinokukweva zvishoma kana uri pamwedzi uyu.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Zuva harina pasi pakaoma sezvakaita Nyika paunogona kumira. Zuva rinoumbwa nemagasi, moto uye plasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Mhepo yacho inowedzera kutetepa painoramba ichienda kure nepakati peZuva.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Chiedza chatinoona chakatenderedza zuva mudenga chinonzi photosphere, izvo zvinoreva kuti "bhora rechiedza."
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Papfuura makore 3 000, mugore ra1610, nyanzvi yekuItaly yekuongorora zviri muchadenga, Galileo Galilei, akashandisa teresikopu akaona kuti Venus inochinja chinja zvayakaita, sezvinoitawo mwedzi.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Kukamuraniswa kunoitika nekuda bedzi kwekuti divi reVhenasi (kana kuti reMwedzi) rakanangana nezuva ndiro rinowana chiedza. Zvikamu zveVhenasi zvinotsigira dzidziso yaCopernicus yekuti mapuraneti anofamba achipoterera Zuva.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Zvadaro, mumakore mashomanana pashure muna 1639, imwe nyanzvi yezvenyeredzi yeChichena inonzi Jeremiah Horrocks yakaongorora kufamba kweVenus.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: England yakanga yava nenguva yakareba iine runyararo kubva payakatora zvakare nharaunda dzinonzi Danelaw.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Zvisinei muna 1991, Ethelred akatarisana nevarwi vakawanda vakauya nezvikepe zvaViking, uye vainge vakawanda kubvira pazvakapedzisira kuitika makore 100 ainge apfuura pakamboonekwawo mauto aGuthrum.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Aitungamirira wacho ainzi Olaf Trygvasson, wekuNorway uyo aida kusunungura nyika yavo pasi peutongi hweDenmark.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Mushure mekukundwa muhondo, Ethelred akagona kuita chibvumirano naOlaf, uyo akadzokera kuNorway kunoedza kutora umambo hwake uye kubudirira kwake kwaiva musanganiswa.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Arufabheti yeHanguel ndiyo chete arufabheti yakanyorwa iine chinangwa chiri kushandiswa zuva nezuva. Arufabheti iyi yakatanga kushandiswa muna 1444 paitonga Mambo Sejong, (uyo akatonga kubva mugore ra1418 kusvika 1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Mambo Sejong ndiye mambo wechi4 weUmambo hweJoseon Dynasty uye ndiye mumwe wevanonyanya kukosheswa.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Zita rekutanga raakatumidza arufabheti yeHangeul nderekuti Hunmin Jeongeum, izvo zvinoreva "kurira kwakarurama kwekudzidzisa vanhu".
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Pane pfungwa dzakawanda dzekuti Sanskrit yakavapo nenzira ipi. Imwe yacho ndeye kutama kwevaAryan vachibva kumadokero vachipinda muIndia avo vanova vakauya nemutauro wavo.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: ChiSanskrit mutauro waishandiswa kare uye wakada kufanana nechiLatin chinoshandiswa kuEurope.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Bhuku rekare kupfuura ese pasi rese rinozivikanwa rakanyorwa muchiSanskrit. Mushure mekunyorwa kwechinyorwa chechitendero chinonzi Upanishads, mutauro weSanskrit wakazoderera kushandiswa nekuda kweutungamiriri.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Mutauro wechiSanskrit mutauro uzere nezvakawanda zvawakanakira, uye mimwe mitauro yakawanda yekuIndia ndomayakabva, kungofanana neLatin iyo yakazozvara mitauro yekuEurope yakadai seFrench neSpanish.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Pakapera hondo yeFrance, Germany yakatanga kugadzirira, kupamba chitsuwi cheBritain.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Nyika yeGermany yakadaidza kurwisa uku nezita rekuvanza rekuti "Operation Sealion". Zvekurwisa zvakakura zvakawanda nezvekushandisa zvemauto eBritain zvaiva zvatsakatika pavakabva kuDunkirk, nekudaro varwi vaive vasina kunyatsosimba.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Asiwo Royal Navy yaive nesimba rakawanda kudarika reGerman Navy ("Kriegsmarine") zvakare yaikwanisa kunge yakaparadza chero mauto ekupamba akatumirwa kuyambuka English Channel.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Kunyangwe zvazvo, ngarava shoma dzeRoyal Navy dzaive dzakagariswa padhuze nenzira dzaigona kupambwa sezvo vatyairi vaitya kunyudzwa nendege dzeGerman dzairwisa mudenga.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Ngatitangei netsanangudzo yezvirongwa zveItaly. Italy yainge iri "munin'ina" weGermany neJapan.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Yaiva nemasoja asina simba uye zvekushandisa kurwa mumvura zvisina tsarukano, kunyange zvazvo vainge vachangobva kuvaka ngarava itsva hondo isati yatanga.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Zvinangwa zvikuru zveItaly zvaive nyika dzemu Africa. Kuti vatore nyika idzodzo, vaizofanirwa kuve nepekuti mauto atangire, kuitira kuti mauto akwanise kuyambuka Gungwa reMediterranean nekuzopamba muAfrica.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Nekuda kwaizvozvo, vaifanira kubvisa mabhesi eBritain nezvikepe zvemuIjipita. Kunze kwezviito izvi, zvikepe zvehondo zvekuItaly zvaisafanira kuita chero chinhu.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Zvino kuJapan. Japan yaiva nyika inechitsuwa, izvo zvakafanana neBritain.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Ngarava dzinofambira pasi penyanza zvikepe zvakaitwa kuti zvikwanise kufambira pasi pemvura, uye zvoramba zvirimo kwenguva yakawanda zvikuru.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Ngarava dzinofambira pasi pemvura dzaishandiswa muHondo Yenyika Yekutanga nemuHondo Yenyika Yechipiri. Kare ikako ngarava dzacho dzaifamba zvishoma nezvishoma uye dzaisanyatsokwanisa kubhomba nzvimbo dziri kure.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Pakatanga hondo vaiwanzofamba nepamusoro pegungwa, asi pakatanga kugadzirwa muchina we-radar uye uchinyatsoshanda nemazvo, vakatanga kufambira pasi pemvura kuti vasaonekwa.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Ngarava dzekuGerman dzainzi maU-Boats. Vanhu vekuGermany vaigona kufambisa ngarava dzavo neunyanzvi.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Nekuda kwekubudirira kwavo kushandisa masabhumarini, pakapera hondo maJerimani vanofungidzirwa kuti havasisina akawanda.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Mambo ainzi Tutankhamun, pamwe pacho achinziwo "Mambo Tut" kana "Mambo wechikomana", aiva mambo wekuIjipiti, uye achiri kuyeukwa zvakanyanya mazuva ano.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Haana kumbobvita aita mbiri uye zita rake haripo pamadzimambo ekare.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Kunyange zvakadaro, kuwanikwa kweguva rake muna1922 kwakaita kuti ave nemukurumbira. Nyangwe zvavo makuva mazhinji enguva rapfuura akabiwa, guva iri rakasiiwa risina kuvhiringidzwa.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Zvinhu zvakavigwa muguva raTutankhamun zvakanyatsochengetedzwa, kusanganisira zviuru zvesimbi nematombo anokosha.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Ruzivo rwekugadzirwa kwemavhiri ane masipokisi kwakaita kuti ngoro dzeAsiriya dzireruke, dzimhanye zvikuru, uye dzive dzakakodzera zvikuru kumhanya kupfuura masoja uye dzimwe ngoro dzehondo.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Miseve yaibuda pauta hwavo hwaiuraya, yaigona kutopinda nemukati menhumbi dzekuzvidzivirira dzemasoja avairwisana nawo. Munenge muna 1000 B.C., vaAssyria ndivo vakatanga kuva neuto remabhiza.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Aya mauto anorwa ari pamabhiza. Chigaro chepabhiza chakanga chisati chavako, saka mauto ekuAsiriya akarwisa ari pamisana yemabhiza isina zvekugarira.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Isu tinoziva kuti vezvematongerwo enyika vechiGiriki , nemasayendisiti, nevavezi. Zvichida munhu anozivikanwa zvikutu wetsika idzi ndi Home, mudetembi bodu aiva nembiri, uyo akanyorwa mabhuku maviriechiGiriki: nhetembo iLiad naOdyssey.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles naAristophanes vachakakurumbira nanhasi nekuda kwemitambo yavo, uye mitambo yavo inoverengwa pamitambo yakanyorwa nemandorokwati.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Mumwe muGiriki akakurumbira inyanzvi yemasvomhu, Pythagoras, uyo anozivikanwa zvakanyanya nesvomhu yekubatana kwakaita mativi etriangle.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Pane fungidziro dzakasiyana-siyana dzekuti vanhu vangani vanotaura chiHindi. Zvinofungidzirwa kuti ndiwo mutauro uri pakati pewechipiri kana wechina pamitauro inotaurwa nevakawanda pasi rese.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Huwandu hwevanotaura mutauro munyika hunosiyana zvichienderana nekuti mitauro yakada kufanana nawo iri kuverengerwapo here kana kuti kwete.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Zvinofungidzirwa kuti pane vanhu vanotaura mutauro uyu 340 miriyoni kusvika ku500 miriyoni, uye vanhu vanotosvika 800 miriyoni vanokwanisa kunzwisisa mutauro wacho.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Madudzirwo emashoko emutauro wechiHindi newechiUrdu akada kufanana, asi pakuanyora akasiyana; kakawanda kacho vanhu vemitauro iyi vanonzwanana pavanenge vachitaura sezvavanoita mazuva ese.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Mumakore ekuma1400, vanhu vekuEstonia vainyanya kutevedzera tsika dzekuGermany.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Mamwe mamongi aida kuti Mwari ave pedyo nevanhu veko saka vakagadzira mutauro wekuEstonia.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Raibva pamavara earufabheti yechiGerman uye rimwe vara rakawedzerwa ndeiri: "O/o".
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Nekufamba kwaiita nguva, mazwi akawanda akabva kumutauro wechiGerman akabatanidzwa. Uku ndiko kwaitova kutanga kuvandudzika kwezvinhu.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Zvaiwanzoitwa ndezvekuti munhu aizotevera pachigaro achingopedza chikoro, ainzi aende kuchikoro chekuva muuto.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Zvisinei, Charles akaenda kuchikoro chepamusoro paKoreji yeTrinity, kuCambridge kwaakanoverenga Anthropology neArchaeology, kuchizoteverwa History, akabuda ne2: 2 ( chikamu chechipiri chepasi chedhigirii).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles aiva nhengo yekutanga yemhuri yehumambo yekuHingirandi kupihwa dhigiri.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: European Turkey (kumabvazuva kweThrace kana kuti Rumelia iri kuBalkan Peninsula) inosanganisira 3 muzana yenyika.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Turkey yakareba makiromita anopfuura 1,600 (mamaira 1,000) uye yakafara makiromita 800 (mamaira 500), uye shepi yenyika yacho yakada kuita serectangle.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Nzvimbo yeTurkey, kubatanidza nyanza, inofukidza nzvimbo yemakiromita 783,562 kumativi ose (300,948 sq mi), nepo nzvimbo yakakura makiromita 755,688 kumativi ose (291,773 sq mi) iri kumaodzanyemba kwakadziva kumadokera kweAsia, uye nzvimbo yakakura makiromita 23,764 kumativi ose (9,174 sq mi) iri muEurope.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Nharaunda yeTurkey inoiita nyika yechi37 pasi rose, uye yakakura seGuta reFrance neUnited Kingdom zvakabatanidzwa.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turkey yakatenderedzwa nemakungwa kumativi matatu: Gungwa reAEgean kumadokero, rinonzi Black Sea kumaodzanyemba reMediterranean kuChamhembe.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxembourg ine nhoroondo yakareba, asi yakava nyika yakazvimirira mugore ra1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Mativi eBelgium ezuva ranhasi aive chikamu cheLuxembourg kare asi zvikazove zvechiBelgian pakapera Belgian Revolution yekuma1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luxembourg yakaramba ichizama kugara iri nyika isina divi rainotsigira asi muHondo Yenyika I neHondo Yenyika II yakagarwa neGermany.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Mugore ra1957 Luxembourg akava nhengo yakatanga sangano rave kuzivikanwa nhasi seMubatanidzwa weNyika DzemuYuropu.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong inzvimbo yemauto yakaondomorwa uye nedzimba dzemaBuddha dziri kurutivi rwekumusoro kweDunhu reParo (riri muNharaunda yePhondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Zvinonzi mugore ra1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel akavaka nzvimbo yekuhwanda yakakura, yekuti ayeuke kuhwina kwaakaita paakarwisa mauto eTibetan-Mongol.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Muna 1951, moto wakakonzera kuti pangosara zvinhu zvishoma zveDrukgyal Dzong, zvakadai semufananidzo waZhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Pakapera moto, nhare yakachengetedzwa nekudzivirirwa, ichisara ichiri chimwe chiratidzo chinonakidza muBhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Panguva yezana regore rechi18 Cambodia yakaona yatodzvinyirirwa pakati pevavakidzani vaviri vane chisimba, Thailand neVietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Vanhu verudzi rweThai vakapamba Cambodia ruzhinji mumakore ezana rechi18 zvakare muna 1772 vakaparadza Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Mukupera kwemakore ezana remakore rechi18 vanhu vekuVietnam vakapambawo Cambodia.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Zvikamu gumi nesere kubva muzana zvevanhu vekuVenezuela havashandi, uye vazhinji vevanoshanda vacho vanozvishandira vega.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Vanhu vakawanda verudzi rwevaVenzuelan vanoshanda mabasa ekubatsira ruzhinji, kota inoshanda mumaindasitiri, kwozoitawo chimwe chikamu chinoshanda muminda.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Indasitiri ine hukoshi muVenezuela ndeye mafuta edzimotokari, uko nyika iyi iriyo yega inotengesera dzimwe nyika, kunyange hazvo pesendi imwe chete muzana ichishanda muindasitiri yemafuta edzimotokari.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Nyika yacho ichangobva kuwana kuzvitonga kuzere, unyanzvi hwekuSingapore Botanic Gardens' hwakabatsira pakuita kuti chitsuwa chacho chive guta rinoyevedza.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Mugore ra1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, rerudzi rwakajairika, rakasarudzwa seruva rakanakisisa renyika.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Gore rega rega mumwedzi waGumiguru mhuka dzinodya masora dzinosvika mamiriyoni 1.5 dzinofamba dzichienda kumapani ekuchamhembe, dzichiyambuka rwizi rweMara, kubva kumakomo ekumaodzanyemba dzichimirira kunaya kwemvura.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Uye tichidzokera zvakare kuchamhembe tichipfuura nekumadokero, topfuura zvakare nemurwizi rweMara, mushure mekunaya kwemvura munenge muna Kubvumbi.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Nharaunda yeSerengeti inosanganisira Serengeti National Park, Ngorongoro Conservation Area uye Maswa Game Reserve iri kuTanzania uye Maasai Mara National Reserve iri kuKenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Kudzidzira zvekugadzira mavhidhiyo nemapikicha ekusanganisa nezvimwe zvekushandisa kunoda unyanzvi hutsva uye hwakare, uye nematurusi anowanikwa mumakirasi ekudzidzira kugadzira mavhidhiyo (kunyorwa kwenyaya, kugadziriswa kwemashoko ekuteerera nevhidhiyo, nhaurwa yacho, nezvimwewo)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Kuumbwa kwekudyidzana kunoda kuti iwe uongorore zvakare zvaunofungidzira pane zvekugadzirwa kwenhau uye kudzidza kufunga munzira dzisina mutsetse.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Zvinhu zvaunenge wagadzira zvinofanira kuenderana, asi zvichikwanisa kuva nezvazvinoreva zvakazvimirira zvega.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Zvakaipira ma zoom lense ndezvekuti zvinodiwa pakunyatsoona uye huwandu hwemalense anodiwa kuti uwane kunyatsoona hwakakura kwazvo kupfuura maprime lense.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Iri harisisiri dambudziko sezvo vanogadzira malens vava kukwanisa kugadzira malens zvemhando yepamusoro.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Izvi zvakaita kuti pabude mifananidzo yemhando yepamusoro yakafanana neyakachengetwa yakatorwa necamera yaingonanga pachinhu isingachiunze padhuze kana kuchiendesa kure.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Chimwe chakaipira mazoom lense ndechekuti mafambiro apamagumo (kumhanya) elens anenge akaderera.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Izvi zvinoita kuti makamera asinganyanyodhura anetse kushandisa munzvimbo isina chiedza chakanyanya kana pasina chiedza chinopenyesa chepakamera.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Zvinowanzoitika pakuedza kuchinja firimu kuti rive DVD ndezvekuti mifananidzo haizobude zvakanaka.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Materevhizheni mazhinji anogadzirwa nenzira yekugutsa vanhuwo zvavo.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Nechikonzero ichocho, zvese zvaunoona paTV zvaive nemiganhu yakaiswa, kumusoro, pasi uye mumativi.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Izvi zvakagadzirwa kuitira kuti mufananidzo uvhare sikirini rose. Izvo zvinonzi kunzvera kwakapfurikidza.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Asi kana ukagadzira DVD zviri kumucheto zvinobva zvadzimika uye kana vhidhiyo yacho iine mashoko anobuda ari nechepazasi achitsanangura zviri kutaurwa, haazonyatsooneka.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Dzimba dzechinyakare dzinopa fungidziro yakadzama, kufungidzira mupfungwa mutambo wekubayana nezvibayiso, mabiko uye mitemo yaArthur.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Kunyange wakamira pamatongo ava nezviuru nezviuru zvemakore, zviri nyore chaizvo kuti uyeuke hondo dzakaitika, uchitoita seuri kunzwa mutsindo wemabhiza uye hwema hwematirongo aichengeterwa vasungwa.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Asiwo zviroto zvepfungwa dzedu zvakamisikidzwa pachokwadi here? Nemhaka yeyi dzimba dzakavakwa pakutanga? Dzakagadziriswa uye kuvakwa nenzira ipi ?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Zvakajairika zvenguva iyoyo, Kirby Muxloe Castle yakanyanya kuva imba yakavakirirwa kupfuura imbayehumbo yechokwadi.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Mazihwindo mahombe emagirazi ezvivako izvi pamwe chete nemidhuri yacho isina kufara zvaisambokwanisa kumira pakauya varwi vachirwisa vachida kuzviparadza.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Kuma 1480, pakwakatanga kuvakwa naLord Hastings, nyika yacho yaiva nekarunyararo zvekuti yaingozvidzivirira chete kumapoka madiki evapambi.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Kuenzaniswa kwesimba yaiva nzira iyo nyika dzeEurope padzaitsvaga kuchengetedza hutongi hwenyika dzose dzemuEurope.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Mafungiro aiva ekuti nyika dzekuEurope dzitsvage kudzivirira nyika imwechete pakuva nesimba rakawandisa, naizvozvo hurumende dzakawanda dzaishandura vekubatana navo kuitira kuti pave nekuaenzanirana.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Hondo yeSpain Yekupa Masimba yakakonzera hondo yekutanga yaiva nechinangwa chekuenzanisa masimba.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Uku kwaiva kuchinja kukuru kwezvinhu, sezvo hurumende dzenyika dzekuEurope dzakanga dzisisakwanise kuita hondo dzichipa chikonzero chekusiyana kwezvitendero. Saka hondo yemakore 30 ndiyo yega hondo yekupedzisira yakanzi yaiva hondo yechitendero.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Temberi yaArtemis yekuEfeso yakaparadzwa musi wa21 July, 356 BCE uye zvakabva pane zvakaitwa naHerostratus.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Maererano nenyaya yacho, zvaaiita zvaibva pakuda kungova nemukurumbira chete chete. Vanhu vekuEfeso vakataura kuti zita raHerostratus risambofa rakanyorwa chero pai zvapo.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Munyori wenhoroondo wechiGiriki anonzi Strabo akazoona zita racho pava paya, anova ndivo maziviro atava kuita mazuva ano. Temberi yacho yakaparadzwa pausiku hwakazvarwa Alexander Mukuru.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, samambo, akati aida kubhadhara zvaidiwa pakuvakazve temberi, asi akarambirwa. Gare gare, mushure mekufa kwaAlexander, temberi yakavakwazve muna 323 BCE.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Iva nechokwadi chekuti hausi kuomesa ruoko rwako paunenge uchinyora manotsi acho nemazvo, uye edza kusanyanya kufambisa zvakanyanya minwe yako.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Neizvi, unozvinetesa zvishoma nezvishoma sezvinobvira. Yeuka kuti hapana chikonzero chekudzvanya mabhatani nesimba rakanyanya kuti uwedzere vhorumu sepapiyano.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Pakamuchina kanonzi accordion, kuti uwane vhoriyamu yakawanda, unotofanira kushandisa mabhero anenge aine puresha uye anomhanya zvakanyanya.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Mysticism zvinoreva kuronda kuwadzana, kuzivikanwa, kana kuziva zvinhu zvazviri chaizvo, humwari, chokwadi chemweya, kana Mwari.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Mutendi anenge achida kunyatsoziva ega kana kuina mwari.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Vatevereri vanomhanyidzana nedzimwe nzira dzekurarama, kana maitiro anotarisirwa kusimudzira mararamiro iwayo.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Kuuka kunogona kusiyaniswa nezvimwe zvinotendendwa muzvitendero uye pakunamata pakuti ikwo kunonyanya kubva pamanzwiro anoita munhu achinyatsonzwa kuti ari kuziva zviri kuitika, kunyanya zvinenge zviine runyararo, kunzwisisa kwakawedzerwa, mufaro, uye kuzunungutsa muviri.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Sikhism chitendero chekunzvimbo dziri kwadzo dzega dzeIndia. Chakavambira munzvimbo yePunjab muzana remakore rechi15 kubva mukupatsanuka kwakaita sekete mukati metsika yechiHindu.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: VaSikh vanoona zvavanotenda sezvakasiyana nezve chitendero chechiHindu kunyange zvazvo vachibvuma kuti zvakavakirwa mutsika dzechiHindu.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: VaSikh vanodana chitendero chavo kuti Gurmat, rinova shoko rechiPunjabi rinoreva kuti "nzira yaana mazvikokota". Umazvikokota chikamu chinokosha chezvitendero zvese zvekuIndia asi chiSikh chinohukoshesa zvekuti ndihwo musimboti wezvavanodavira muchitendero chavo.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Chitendero ichi chakavambwa mugore regumi neshanu rezviuru naGuru Nanak (1469-1539). Kuchibva kwatevera dzimwe nyanzvi mapfumbamwe dzichiteedzana.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Nekudaro, muna Chikumi 1956, zvainge zvavimbiswa naKruschev zvakaonekwa kuti airevesa here vanhu pavakaratidzira vachitsutsumwa nekuda kwekushaiwa zvekudya uye vachida kuwedzerwa mari yavaitambira, uye panguva iyi vakanga vachishora chiCommunism.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Chero mumagumo, Krushchev akaendesa matangi kunodzoreredza kurongeka, akapawo mukana wekuti pave nezvido zvehupfumi zvakare akatenda kuisa Wladyslaw Gomulka ane mbiri chaizvo seMutungamiriri munyowani.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Budiriro ye Indus Valley yaive yemunguva yeBronze kumaodzanyemba kwakadziva kumadokero kweIndia ichisanganisira yava Pakistan yezuva ranhasi uye mamwe matunhu kumaodzanyemba kwakadziva kumadokero kweIndia zvakare kumaodzanyemba kwakadziva kumabvazuva kweAfghanistan.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Kubudirira uku kwakatangira murwizi rwaIndus uye ndizvo zvakaita kuti kuzopiwa zita iri.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Kunyangwe dzimwe nyanzvi dzichifungidzira kuti maive nehupenyu mumahombekombe erwizi rweSarsvati rwakazooma, inofanira kunzi Indus-Sarasvati Civilisation, vamwewo vachiidaidza kuti Harappan Civilisation zvichibva paHarappa, inova nzvimbo yekutanga kucherwa kuma1920.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Kuda zvehondo kwaiita umambo hweRoma kwakabatsira pakufambira mberi kwezvekurapa.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Ana chiremba vakatanga kupiwa mabasa naMambo Augustus uyewo ndokutanga Vanachiremba veMauto eRoma vekutanga kuti vashandiswe kurapa vanenge vakuvarira kuhondo.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Vana chiremba vekuvhiya vaiva ruzivo rwemishonga yekurarisa inosanganisira morphine iyo yakatorwa mumbeu yepoppy ne scopolamine yakabva kumbeu yeherbane.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Vakazova neunyanzvi hwekudimbura nhengo dzevarwere vanenge vaine nhengo yemuviri inenge yava kuora zvichikonzerwa neropa rinenge ragwamba kana kuti kusafamba kweropa zvakanaka.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Kwemazana emakore mazhinji, humambo hweRoma hwakatungamira mukubudirira kwakanyanya mune zvekurapa uye hwakavandudza ruzivo ruzhinji rwatinoziva munguva ino.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Inodaidzwa kuti Pureland origami iorigami ine kudzoreredzwa kwekuti kupeta kamwechete ndiko kunobvumidzwa panguva, kumwe kupetwa kwemhando yepamusoro hazvibvumidzwe, uye kupetwa kwese kune nzvimbo dzakatwasuka.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Yakagadzirwa naJohn Smith mumakore ekuma1970 kuti abatsire vanhu vaisava neruzivo rwezvekupeta nevamwewo vane nhetemwa.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Vana vanoziva zverudzi uye zvekushorwa kwemarudzi vachiri vadiki uye zvekushorwa kwemarudzi zvinokanganisa hunhu.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Semuenzaniso, vana verudzi runenge ruine vashoma pavanotarisirwa pasi vachinzi havasi kugona chikoro, kakawanda kacho vanotozorega kugona pavanenge vaziva kuti ndomaonerwo ari kuitwa rudzi rwavo nevamwe vanhu vepachikoro ichocho.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace ndiyo webhusaiti yechitatu ine mukurumbira inoshandisiwa muUnited States uye ine mamirioni makumi mashanu nemana evashandisi pari zvino.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Mawebhusaiti aya akawana kutariswa kwakawanda, zvikuru sei muchikamu chezvekudzidza.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Pane zvakanakirawo mawebhusaiti aya, zvinosanganisira kugadzira peji rekirasi zviri nyore, iro rinogona kusanganisira mablog, mavhidhiyo, mifananidzo, nezvimwe zvinhu.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Peji iri rinogona kuwanikwa nyore nekupa kero imwechete yewebhusaiti, izvo zvinoita kuti ive nyore kuyeuka uye nyore kunyorera kuitira vadzidzi vanenge vachinetseka kushandisa keyboard kana nezviperengo.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Inokwanisa kukwenenzverwa kuti iverengeke nenzira isina kuoma nekuvawo nekara zhinji kana shoma sezvinodiwa.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Chirwere chekusakwanisa kuisa pfungwa pachinhu chimwe chete chinokonzerwa neuropi hunenge husisashande zvakanaka, uye zvinooneka nekungoerekana waita chimwe chinhu, kufunga zvakasiyana-siyana panguva imwe chete, uye kushandisa simba rakawanda kupfuura rakakodzera.
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Hausi hurema pakudzidza asi hurwere pakudzidza; "hunokanganisa zvikamu 3 kusvika ku5 kubva muzana revana vese, vanogona kungova mamirioni maviri evana vemuAmerica".
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Vana vane ADD vanoomerwa nekuita zvinhu zvekuchikoro, asi vanokwanisa kunyatsoisa pfungwa dzavo pazvinhu zvavanofarira zvakadai sekutamba mitambo kana kuona makatuni avanofarira kana kuti kunyora mitsara inenge isina nyora dzemutauro.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Vana ava vanosiwanzo kupinda mumatambudziko akawanda, nokuti izvo "vanoita maitiro anenjodzi, vanopinda mukurwa, uye vanopokana nevakuru" kuti vaone zvinoitika muhuropi wavo izvo zvisingakwanisika kuiti zvikurudzirwa nenzira dzakajairika.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: ADD inokanganisa kushamwaridzana pakati pevana vane chirwere ichi nevasina nekuti vasina chirwere chacho havanzwisisi kuti nei vana vane chirwere ichi vaine kamuitiro kavanoita zvinhu uye vachiperetera manzwi saizvozvo uye kuti kukura kwavanoita kwakasiyana nekwavo.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Sezvo nzira dzekuwana nadzo mashoko uye dzekudzidza dzakachinja sezvataurwa pamusoro apo, nguvawo yaiita vanhu vachitsvaga ruzivo yakachinjawo.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Matsvagiro eruzivo aive akasiyana. Kurangarira kwedungamunhu kwanga kusina kumanikidza , asi kugona kuyeuka zvinyorwa kwakave chinangwa chikuru.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Muchokwadi, Renaissance yachinja zvikurumaitiro ekudzidza zvakare nekushambadzirwa kweruzivo.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Zvichisiyana nemamwe makudo, mahominid haachashandise maoko avo mukufamba kana kutakura uremu kana kuzereka mumiti.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Ruoko netsoka zvegorira zvakafanana kukura pamwe chete neurefu, zvichiratidza mashandiro eruoko pakutakura uremu, parinenge richifamba nezvigunwe zvakatarisa pasi.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Ruoko rwemunhu rwakapfupika kupfuura rutsoka, ruine mabhonzo akatwasuka.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Mabhonzo emaoko akura makore mamirioni maviri kusvika matatu anoratidza kuchinja kwehunyanzvi hweruoko kubva pakungosimudzwa ruchienda pamwe kuenda pakunyatsobata chinhu.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Vamwe vanhu vanodavira kuti kuva nemaroto ekuita zvekurongera kakawanda kunopedza simba.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Izvi zvinoitika kana nguva yatinorota asi tichiziva zviri kuitika ikareba zvoita kuti nguva yekubva pane rimwe danho reREM kuenda pane rimwe irebewo.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: NemaREM mashoma husiku nehusiku, mamiriro ezvinhu ekurara chaiko auri kuva nayo muviri wako uchipora zvinowanzosaitika kazhinji kuti pave nedambudziko.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Izvi zvinonetesa sekunge kuti uri kumuka pashure pemaminitsi 20 kusvika ku30 ega ega uchiona TV.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Zvinoitika zvinobva pakuti pfungwa dzako dzinoedza kurota zvinhu zvakajeka sei usiku hwega hwega.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Zvinhu zvakatadza kuitira maItalian zvakanaka muNorth Africa kubva pakutanga. Muvhiki rimwechete Italy yazivisa nezvehondo musi wa 10 June, 1940, ma 11th Hussar eBritain anga atotapa Fort Capuzzo kuLibya.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Britain yakavandira iri nechekumabvazuva kweBardia, ichibva yabata mukuru mukuru wemainjiniya emauto eItaly anonzi General Lastucci.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Musi wa28 Chikumi, Marshal Italo Balbo, mumwe mukuru muhofisi yaGavhuna kuLibya, uyo ainge akasarudzwa kuzogara pachigaro chaMussolini kana afa, akaurayiwa nemoto ndege yaanga ari payakamhara muTobruk ichibva yaputika.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Mutambo wekuridza unonzi fencing uri kuitwa nevanhu vakasiyana-siyana, kubvira kuvadzidzi vepamayunivhesiti kusvikira kuvanhu vane unyanzvi vanoenda kumakwikwi emaOlympics.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Kakawanda mutambo uyu unoitwa nevanhu vaviri, umwe mutambi achirwa nemumwe.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Gorofu mutambo wekuti vanenge vachitamba vanoshandisa zvimuti kurova mabhora achipinda mutukomba.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Vanhu vanenge vachitamba golf vanenge vachida kupinza mumakomba 18, vachirtanga nerekutanga uye vachizopedzisira nerechi18.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Mutambi anorova kashona, kana kuvhizura tsvimbo yegorofu kashoma kudarika vese, kuti apedze chikamu chacho ndiye anohwinha.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Mutambo wacho unotambirwa pauswa, uye uswa hwacho hunenge hwakapoteredza kagomba uye hwakanyatsochekererwa nechepasi uye hunodanwa kuti girini.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Zvichida rudzi rwekushanya rwunonyanyozivikanwa ndeurwo vanhu vanobatanidza nekuvhakacha: Kushanya kwekumbonofurwawo nemhepo.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Ndipo apo vanhu vanoenda kunzvimbo iyo yakasiyana zvakanyanya neupenyu hwavo hwezuva nezuva kuti vambozorora nekufara.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Nzvimbo dzine jecha mumhenderekedzo yegungwa, mekutandarira mune zvinhu zvekutambisa uye nzvimbo dzekuzororera dziri kwadzo dzega inzvimbo dzinowanzoshanyirwa nevashanyi vanenge vachida varayidzo.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Kana munhu achishanya nechinangwa chekuti azive nhoroondo uye tsika dzeimwe nzvimbo, kushanya kwaanenge aita kunonzi kwakanangana nekushanya kwekuongorora tsika dzevanhu.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Vashanyi vanogona kushanyira nzvimbo dzinokosha dzemune imwe nyika, kana kuti vanogona kusarudza kushanyira nzvimbo imwe chete.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Vapambepfumi pavakaona zvinhu izvi zvichiitwa, vakabva vatsvaga rutsigiro.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Varwi vakanga vachisimbisa uto rairwisa nechekumberi vaisanganisira regimendi 1 ne3 yevarume 200 yeNew Hampshire, idzo dzaiva pasi paColonel John Stark uye James Reed (vese vakazova vakuru vemauto).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Varume vaiva kudivi raStark vakaenda pafenzi yainge iri kuchamhembe kwaColonist.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Mvura yakaderera payakatsemura padivi perwizi rweMystic rwakatevedza kumaodzanyemba kwakadziva kumabvazuva kwePeninsula, vakabva vawedzera ruzhohwa nerusvingo rudiki rwematombo nechekumaodzanyemba ruchiperera pamahombekombe emvura nemhenderekedzo duku.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Griley kana Stark vakaisa danda rakareba mafiti 100 (30m) pamberi pefenzi uye vakaraira kuti pasave neanopfura kusvikira vagari vemazuva ose vazopfuura.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.
