text: Nyika yeAmerica yakafunga zano rekubatana pakurwisa ichibva kunzvimbo nhatu dzakasiyana.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Mukuru mukuru wemauto anonzi John Cadwalder aida kurwisa boka revarwi paBordentown, kuti akwanise kumisa vavengi.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Mukuru wemauto James Ewing, aigona kutora mauto 700 kuyambuka rwizi paTrenton Ferry, vobata zambuko pamusoro peAssunpink Creek vodzivirira mauto evavengi kuti apunyuke.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Boka revarwi 2 400 raiyambuka rwizi rwuri mamaira 9 kuchamhembe kweTrenton, uye raizopatsanurwa kuva mapoka maviri, rimwe riri pasi paGreene uye rimwe riri pasi paSullivan, kuti varwise pakunenge kwava kunoedza.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Nekushanduka kwemujaho wekumhanya kubva kukota kusvika kuhafu yemaira, kumhanya zvakanyanya hakuna kukosha asi kutsungirira kunobva kwakoshesesa zvikuru.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Zvechokwadi mumhanyi wepamusoro we hafu-maira, murume anogona kukunda maminitsi maviri, anodiwa kuva nekumhanya kwakati wandeyi, asi kutsungirira kunofanira kuumbiridzwa nepanogoneka pose.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Mujaho wekumhanya makiromita akawanda munguva yechando, pamwe chete nekusimbisa muviri kubvira muchiuno zvichikwira, ndozvinonyanya kubatsira pakugadzirira nguva yekumhanya.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Kudya zvekudya zvinovaka hakusiriko kwega kunoita kuti vechidiki vanyatsoita mitambo nemazvo, asi zvinotobatsira pazvese zvinoitwa nevechidiki mumitambo yacho uye pautano.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Kuringanisa zvine hutano kuchengeta simba, hunhu hune hudzamu hwekunwa mvura, uye kunzwisisa maitiro akasiyana ekuwedzeredza chikafu kunogona kubatsira vamhanyi kuvandudza maitiro avo uye nekuwedzera kunakidzwa kwavo nemutambo.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Kumhanya mumujaho usina kunyanya kureba mutambo usingambodi mari yakawanda, asi kunyange zvakadaro pane nhema dzakawanda dzinotaurwa nevanhu pamusoro pezvishomanana zvinodiwa kuti ukwanise kukwikwidza.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Zvinenge zvagadzirwa zvinogona kutengwa pazvinenge zvichidikanwa, asi zvakawanda zvinenge zvinezvishoma kana kusava nesimudziro pazviito.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Vanhu vanoita zvekumhanya mijaho vanowanzoda kutenga zvinhu kunyange kana zvisina zvazvinovabatsira.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Atomu inogona kutorwa sechimwe chenheyo yakakoshesesa yekuvaka zvinhu zvose.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Harisi nyore kunzwisisa, kuwirirana nechigadzirwa cheBohr, uye rinosanganisira nucleus inenge ichitendererwa nemaelectrons, kuita sezvinoita mapuraneti anenge achitenderera zuva - ona Mufananidzo 1.1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Nucleus inoumbwa nezvinhu zviviri zvinoti maneutron uye maproton.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Mapurotoni anecharge yemagetsi apa maneutron haana chaji. Maerekitirone anemagetsi asina chaji.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Usati wabatsira munhu unofanira kutanga watarisa tarisa nzvimbo yauri kuti iwe usazopinda panjodzi.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Unofanirwa kucherechedza chinzvimbo chemunhu paunenge uchisvika paari kana zvimwe zvaunofanira kuchenjerera.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Kana ukakuvadzwa uchiedza kupa rubatsiro, unogona kungobatsira pakuita kuti zvinhu zvinyanyoipa.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Tsvakurudzo dzakaitwa dzakaratidza kuti kurwadziwa nemusana uye kuremara kwawo zvinowanzobva pakuzvidya mwoyo, kutya uye kufunga kuti zvinhu zvichanyanya kuipa kupfuura zvazviri.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Kukonzeresa kwekuparadza chete, kwete kushushikana uye kutya zvaifanira kuvepo pakugadzirwa kwezvirongwa zvePA zvepavhiki.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Avo vari kubatanidzwa muchiito chenguva dzese vanoda kutsigirwa zvakanyanya munyaya yekuva nemafungiro asina kunaka emarwadzo uchiparadzanisa musiyano wemarwadzo enguva dzose uye kungonzwa kusagadzikana nekufamba kunoita nhengo dzemuviri.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Chiratidzo, kana kuti kugona kuona zvinoenderarana nenhego dzekuona kana maziso.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Kune misiyano yekuuumbwa kwemaziso akawanda, zvichitanga kubva mukuomarara zvichienderana nezvinodiwa nemuviri.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Zvivakwa zvakasiyana siyana zvine zvazvakanakira zvakasiyana, zvinodairira mawave-length akasiyana, mamiriro azvinenge zvakaita akasiyana, uye zvine manhamba akasiyana ezvese zvinodiwa kuti zvishande zvakanaka.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Uwandu hwezvinorarama mubatanidzwa wezvinhu zvipenyu zverudzi rumwe zviri munzvimbo yakati.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Kana vanhu vese vari munzvimbo vakafanana mumaitiro avo vanozivikanwa severudzi rumwe.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Vanhu pavanoratidza unhu hwakafanana asi vachizviita nenzira dzakasiyana vanonzi vari polymorphic.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Makoroni emauto emasvosve anofora uye kuita dendere muzvinhanho zvakasiyanawo zvakare.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Pakutama-tama, masvosve anoshanda semauto anofora husiku uye anomira kugara pakati pezuva.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Masvosve anotanga kufamba kana chikafu chinenge chiripo chava chishoma. Panguva iyi, anotanga kugadzira tumwena tunenge tuchichinjwa mazuva ese.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Kumwe nekumwe kufamba kune mhirizhonga nekufora kunogona kutora mazuva anenge 17.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Chii chinonzi sero? Izwi iri rinobva paizwi rechiLatin rekuti "cella", rinoreva "imba diki", uye rakatanga kushandiswa nenyanzvi pakushandisa maikorosikopu iyo yaitarisa mamiriro echikokore.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Sero ndiro hwaro hwechinhu chese chinorarama, uye twunhu twese twupenyu twunoumbwa nesero rimwe kana kuti akawanda.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Masero ndiwo hwaro pakudzidza nezve upenyu, kutaura zvazviri, anowanzonzi "zvidhina zvinowaka upenyu".
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Nervous system inochengetedza homeostasis nekutumira manerve impulse mumuviri wese kuitira kuti kufamba kweropa kusakanganisika.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Kutamba tamba kwetsinga kunogona kufamba nemuviri nekukurumidza, zvichibatsira kuumbiridza muviri pane zvingangova nenjodzi.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Madutumupengo anonzi Tornado anofamba nzvimbo diki kana achienzaniswa nemamwe madutumupengo, asi anogona kuparadza chese chinenge chiri munzira yawo.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Madutu ane simba anonzi maTornado anodzura miti, anoparadza zvivakwa, uye anosimudza motokari achidzikanda mudenga. Madutu maviri pazana erudzi urwu anotora nguva inoita maawa anopfuura matatu.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Madutu mupengo anotyisa aya anenge aine mhepo iri kumhanya 480 km/hr (133m/s; 300mph).
text_en: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: Kwemakore zviuru nezviuru, vanhu vanga vachiburitsa nekusevenzesa marenzi kuti zvinhu zviratidzike zvakakura.
text_en: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: Zvisinei, materesikopu chaiwo akagadzirwa muEurope mumakore ekuma1500 ava kunopera.
text_en: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Materesikopu aya aiita kuti zvinhu zviri kure zviuye pedyo uye zvioneke zvakanyatsokura.
text_en: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: Kuda kuita zvakakunakira kuchagara kuripo nekuti kunyange kana vanhu vakawanda vachiwana zvavanoda, pasina kana nguva munhu anogona kuwana zvakawanda kana akangofunga zvakamunakira asingafungi vamwe.
text_en: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: Ndinotenda kuti, vakawanda vanozoziva kuti chisarudzo chakanakisisa kwavari chenguva refu ndechemushandira pamwe.
text_en: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Kune vakawanda vanoda kuzonzwa kuti zvava kuita kushanyira imwe nyeredzi kana kuti dzimwe nyika dziri muchadenga, vamwe vanonetseka kuti kumbori nechii uye vamwe vanofunga kuti kunogara maalien kana kuti pane zvimwe zvinhu zvipenyu zvinogara ikoko.
text_en: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Asi kunyange zvikaitika, hazvizoitike nguva refu. Nyeredzi dzacho dziri kure nekure zvekuti pakati padzo panenge paine mamaira anosvika matririyoni.
text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Zvinogona kuzoitika kuti rimwe zuva, vana vevazukuru vako vachange vakamira pamusoro penyika yevatorwa nyika vachifunga nezvemadzitateguru avo ekare?
text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: Mhuka dzinogadzirwa nemasero akawanda. Dzinodya zvinhu dzozvigaya. Dzakawanda dzinokwanisa kufamba.
text_en: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Mhuka bedzi ndidzo dzine pfungwa (kunyangwe dzisiri mhuka dzese dzinahwo, jellyfish, somuenzaniso haina pfungwa).
text_en: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: Mhuka dzinowanikwa pasi rose. Dzinochera pasi, dzinodhidha mumakungwa, uye dzinobhururuka mudenga.
text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Sero ndiro chikamu chidikisa chinoumba zvinhu zvipenyu.
text_en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Shoko rekuti sero rinotorwa pashoko rechi Latin rekuti cella iro rinoreva kanzvimbo kadiki.
text_en: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Kana ukatarisa zvinhu zvinofema pasi pemaikorosikopu, zvinoonekwa kuti zvakagadzirwa netumasikweya tudiki kana tubhora.
text_en: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, muongorori wezvinhu zvipenyu wekuEngland, akaona mabhokisi mabhokisi mucork, paaitarisa nemaikorosikopu.
text_en: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Aiita semakamuri. Ndiye akava munhu wekutanga kuona masero akafa.
text_en: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: Maeremendi nemakombaundi anokwanisa kushanduka kubva kumamwe mamiriro achienda kune mamwe uye asingashanduke.
text_en: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: Nitrogen segasi inoumbwa zvimwechete nenitrogen yemvura. Chimiro chemvura chakakorera asizve mamorekuru mamwe chete.
text_en: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: Mumwe muenzaniso imvura. Mvura yakazara inoumbwa nemaatomu maviri ehydrogen uye atomu rimwe reokisijeni.
text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: Ine mamiriro akafanana emamomekuru kana chingava mhepo, mvura kana chakasimba.
text_en: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Nyangwe zvazva chimiro chayo chingachinja, zvakaita makemikari hazvichinji.
text_en: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: Nguva chinhu chatinogara tiinacho, uye tinoishandisa pazvese zvatinoita, asi yakaoma chaizvo kuinzwisisa.
text_en: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: Nguva yava nemakore nemakore ichidzidzwa nevanhu vakawanda vanosanganisira vezvitendero, vanoita zvephilosophy, uyewo vadzidzi vesainzi.
text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Tinotarisa nguva tichibva kune zviri mberi tichidzoka pane zviri kuitika iye zvino uye tichizotarisawo zviri shure.
text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: Nguva kuyerawo kwatinoita kureba (hurebu) kwezvinoitika.
text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Unogona kuziva mafambiro anoita nguva kana ukacherechedza kuti zvinhu zvipi zvinogara zvichiitika. Chinhu chinogara chichiitika, chinhu chekuti kunyange zvikaita sei hachirege kuitika.
text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Makombiyuta ari kushandiswa nhasi kuchinja maonekere emifananidzo uye mavhidiyo.
text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Makatuni akagadzirwa zvemhando yepamusoro anogona kugadzirwa pakombiyuta, uye ari kuramba achiwedzera kugadzirwa achiratidzwa pamaterevhizheni nemafirimu.
text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: Mimhanzi inonyanya kurekodhiwa vachishandisa makombiyuta ehunyanzvi kuti agadzirise nekusanganisa ruzha rwacho pamwe chete.
text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Kwemakore akawanda kuma1800 zvichienda kuma1900, zvainzi vanhu vakatanga kugara kuNew Zealand ndeverudzi rwechiMaori, uye kuti vaivhima shiri dzakakura dzinonzi moas.
text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: Dzidziso yacho yakabva yasimbisira mafungiro ekuti vaMaori vakatama vachibva kuPolynesia seBoka Guru ndokutorera vaMoriori nyika yeNew Zealand, vachibva vaita kuti vanhu vaite zvekurima.
text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Zvisinei, hufakazi huchangovepo hunopa pfungwa yekuti vaMoriori vaive chikwata chevanhu vechiMaori vakatama kuZealand vachienda kuZvitsuva zveChatham, vachiumba tsika dzavo dzakasiyana, dzine runyararo.
text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: Kwaivawo zvakare nerumwe rudzi rwaiva pazvitsuwa zveChatham, urwo rwaiva vanhu vechiMaori vakatama kubva kuNew Zealand.
text_en: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Vanhu ava vaiti ndeverudzi rwechiMoriori, uye vairwisana zvekuti pakupedzisira, rudzi urwu rwakaparara.
text_en: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: Vanhu vakashanda pamwe kwemakumi emakore akawanda vakatibatsira kuti tigutsikane nezvatinokwanisa uye zvishuwo zvedu ukuwo wachiongorora zvakatiomera kunyangewo zvatakakundikana.
text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Pataiteerera nyaya dzaitaurwa nemunhu mumwe chete, mhuri kana kuti sangano, takasvika pakuona zvaiitika kare uye kuziva vamwe vanhu vakabatsira kana kuti kukanganisa maitiro esangano racho.
text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Chero hazvo kunzwisisa nhoroondo yemunhu kusingareve kunzwisiswa tsika, zvinobatsira vanhu kuti vawane muonero yezvavanozobatana maringe nenhoroondo yekambani.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Pakupenengura zvakabudirira nekuziva zvakakundikana, vanhu uye vese vaibatanidzwa vakanzwisisa zvakadzama tsika, zvinangwa nezvinofambisira mberi basa pakambani.
text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Muchiitiko ichi, kudzora zviitika zvakapfuura zvehunhu hwebhizimusi uye mhedzisiro yebudiriro zvakabetsera vanhu kuti vave vakazaruka pane shanduko itsva uye gwara idzva rekereke yemuno.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Nyaya dzakadaro dzebudiriro dzakaderedza rutyo rwekuchinja, ukuwo rwuchiumba mafungiro akanaka ekuchinja munguva yemberi.
text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Kusanganisa pfungwa hunyanzvi hwekugadzirisa zvinetso hunosanganisa mazano kana nzira dzakasiyana siyana pakutsvaka nzira inoshanda.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: Chinangwa chemafungiro aya kukasika, kurongeka nekuita nemo nemo, uye kuona chokwadi, kuita maitiro agara aripo, kuunganidza ruzivo.
text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: Chinhu chinokosha pakuva nemafungiro aya ndechekuziva kuti kunongova nemhinduro imwe chete yakanaka. Saka unofanira kufunga nezvemhinduro mbiri chete, imwe yacho inenge yakanaka uye imwe yacho inenge isina.
text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Mafungiro akadai anowanzobva paimwe mhando yesayenzi kana kuti mamwe maitiro akaongororwa akaonekwa kuti anoshanda.
text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: Vanhu vane mafungiro aya vane pfungwa dzakajeka, vanogona kuchengeta mapatani mumusoro, kugadzirisa matambudziko uye kusevenza paongororo dzesainzi.
text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Vanhu ndivo vanokwanisa chaizvo kuona zviri kufungwa nevamwe kupfuura zvimwe zvisikwa zvese.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Izvi zvinoreva kuti isu tinokwanisa kufembera mifungiro yevamwe vanhu, zvavanoda kuita, zvavanotenda, zvavanoziva kana zvavanoda.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Pakati pekukwanisa izvi, kunzwisisa vavariro dzevamwe kwakakosha. Kunoita kuti tikwanise kuziva zvingangove zviri zvikonzero zvekuitwa kwezvimwe zvinhu.
text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Semuenzaniso, kana ukaona munhu achitema hwindo remota, unogona kufunga kuti ari kuda kuba mota yemunhu.
text_en: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: Asi aisazoonekwa saizvozvo kudai akanga arasa makiyi emota yake uye iri mota yake yaari kuedza kupaza.
text_en: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: MRI inobva pasayenzi isinganyatsonzwisiswa inonzi nuclear magnetic resonance (MNR), yakawanika kuma 1930 naFelix Bloch (wepaStanford University) uye Edward Purcell (wepaHarvard University).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Mukuita uku, panobata magnet nemasaisai eRadio panokonzeresa kuti maatomu abudise masaisai eradio.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Mugore ra1970, Raymond Damadian, chiremba uye mutsvakurudzi, akawana hwaro hwekushandisa kutora mifananidzo yemagineti sechishandiso kungoorora zvekurapwa.
text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Makore mana gare gare, rezinesi rakapiwa, raiva rezinesi rekutanga kupiwa pasi rese munharaunda yeMRI.
text_en: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Muna 1977, Dr Damadian vakapedza kugadzira MRI scanner yaiona muviri wese, iyo yavakati "Indomitable".
text_en: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: Nzira yekudzidza inonzi Asynchronous Communication inokurudzira kuti munhu awane nguva yekufungisisa uye kukurukura nevamwe.
text_en: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: Inopa vadzidzi mukana wekuita zvinoenderana nezvavanokwanisa uye wekufambidzana nemirayiridzo nemanzwisisiro avanoita.
text_en: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Zvinhu zvishoma zvaunenge uchisungirwa kuita uye unokwanisawo kuchinja maawa aunoshanda. (Bremer, 1998)
text_en: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: Kushandiswa kweindaneti uye World Wide Web, kunoita kuti vadzidzi vave nemukana wekuwana mashoko chero nguva.
text_en: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: Vana vechikoro vanogonawo kutumira mibvunzo kuvadzidzisi chero nguva ipi yezuva uye votarisira mhinduro nekukurumidza, pane kumirira apo pavanozosangana vachionana.
text_en: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: Dzidzo yemhando iyi inopa mukana wekusarudza. Hakuna nzira imwe chete inonzi ndiyo yakanaka yekudzidza.
text_en: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: Mukurevesa, hakuna kana chakanaka chekufunda. Kufunda kunoitika panosangana mudzidzi neruzivo runenge ruchidzidziswa.
text_en: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Zvatasangana nazvo parizvino pamusoro pekuti munhu azvibatsire pachake uye kupihwa ruzivo, kudzidza kubva paterevhizheni, zvinoratidza izvi.
text_en: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Saka vazhinji vedu tinozviwana tichiona zviitiko zvepaterevhizheni zvinotiratidza maitiro kana zvehupenyu zvatisingazove chikamu kana kushandisa ruzivo urwu.
text_en: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Hatimbogadzirise mota, kuvaka kasipiti kemvura kuseri kwemba, kushanyira Peru kuti tinoona matongo, kana kuti kugadzirisa imba yemuvakidzani wedu.
text_en: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: Nekuda kwetambo dzefiber optic dziri pasi pegungwa dzinobatanidza Europe paindaneti, Greenland yakanyatsobatana ne vanhu vanoshandisa indaneti avo vanosvika 93%.
text_en: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Hotera kana vawashanyira (kana uri kugara imba yevaenzi kana pamba pemhuri) vanogona kuva newifi kana indaneti yakabatanidzwa pakombiuta, zvakare nharaunda zhinji dzine nzvimbo dzekuenda paindaneti kana pamwewo pane wifi yevanhu vakawanda.
text_en: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Sezvataurwa pamusoro apo, shoko rekuti "Eksimo" richiri kushandiswa kuUnited States, asi vanhu vasiri zvizvarwa zvekuUnited States vanoti shoko racho nderekutsvinya, kunyanya vanhu vakabva kuArctic vari kuCanada.
text_en: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Kunyange unganzwa shoko rinoshandiswa Nevagari vemuGreenland, kushandiswa kwaro kunofanira kusaitwa nevabvakure.
text_en: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: Zvizvarwa zvemuGreenland zvinozvidaidza kuti Inuit muCanada uye Kalaalleq (Kalaallit muhuzhinji), Greenlander, muGreenland.
text_en: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: MuGreenland hamuna zvekuparwa kwemhosva kana kubatwa zvisina kunaka kwevashanyi. Kunyange mumaguta hamuna nzvimbo dzinonzi dzine ngozi.
text_en: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: Mamiriro ekunze ekutonhora ndiwo ega njodzi chaiyo ingasangana neasina kugadzirira nezvayo.
text_en: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Kana ukashanyira Greenland pamwaka unotonhora (wakatarisa kuti kunyanya kwaunoenda kumaodzanyemba, kunowedzerawo kutonhora), zvakakosha kuuya nehembe dzonodziya.
text_en: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: Nguva yezhizha nguva yakunenge kwakachena inenge yakareba izvo zvinowanzokonzera matambudziko ekutadza kurara nemamwe matambudziko eutano.
text_en: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Munguva yekupisa, ngwarira umhutu hwerudzi rweNordic. Kunyange zvazvo dzisingakonzere zvirwere, dzinosvota.
text_en: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Apo hupfumi hweSan Francisco huchibatanidzwa nekuva kwayo mukwezvi wevashanyi wemhando yepamusoro pasi rose, hupfumi hwayo hunobva mune zvakawanda wanda.
text_en: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: Vashandi vakawanda vari mumakambani, muhurumende, makambani emari, ezvekutengeserana uye zvekusharanganya.
text_en: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Kubudiswa kweguta iri mumafirimu, mimhanzi, mabhuku, uye mutsika dzinonyanya kuzivikanwa kwakaita kuti guta iri nezvakawanda zviri mariri zvizivikanwe pasi rese.
text_en: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: San Francisco yakavaka zvivako zvakawanda zvevashanyi nemahotera akawanda, maresitorendi, nenzvimbo dzakanaka dzekuitira magungano.
text_en: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco ndiyo imwe yenzvimbo dzakanakisisa dzine zvekudya zvekuAsia; unowana zvenyika idzi: Korea, Thai, India, uye Japan.
text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: Kushanyira Walt Disney World rwendo runotoonekwa serwendo rwakakosha zvikuru nemhuri dzakawanda dzekuAmerica.
text_en: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: Kushanya "kwakajairika" kunosanganisira kubhururuka kuenda kunhandare yendege yeOrlando International, kukwira bhazi kuenda kuhotera iri panzvimbo yeDisney, kupedza rinenge vhiki usina kumbobva panzvimbo yeDisney, nekudzokera kumba.
text_en: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: Pane misiyano mizhinji inokwanisika, asi izvozvo zvinoramba zviri izvo vanhu vazhinji vanoreva kana vachitaura "nezvekuenda kuDisney World".
text_en: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Matikiti akawanda anotengeswa paindaneti panzvimbo dzakadai seEbay kana kuti Craigslist anenge akabhadharwa kuti ashandiswe pakushanyira mapaki kwemazuva akati wandei.
text_en: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Kunyange zvazvo zvichiwanzoitwa, vekuDisney havazvide; matiketi acho haagone kuchinjwa.
text_en: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Kuisa misasa ipi zvayo pasi pemupendero kuGrand Canyon kunoda mvumo yekudzokera kunze kwenyika.
text_en: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Mapepa emvumo anoitwa kuti ave maashoma kuitira kuchengetedza goronga, uye anowapo musi wekutanga wemwedzi, pachiine mwedzi mina mwedzi wakutanga usati wasvika.
text_en: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Backcountry permit inoda kuzoshandiswa kutanga muna May inenge yavapo musi wa1 Jan.
text_en: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Nzvimbo dzakawanda dzakakurumbira, seinonzi Bright Angel Campground, iri pedyo nePhantom Ranch, dzinowanzobhukwa pazuva rekutanga radzinovhurwa.
text_en: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Kune mvumo shoma dzakachengeterwa mikumbiro yevanongozvifambira dzichiphwa anenge atanga kuuya.
text_en: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Kupinda muSouth Africa nemota inzira yakanaka chaizvo yekuona kuyevedza kwenyika yacho uye yekupfuura nemunzvimbo dzisingawanzosvika vashanyi.
text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Izvi zvinokwaniswa kuitwa nechero mota nekuziva zvekuita asi mota inodhonza nemavhiri ose ye4x4 ndiyo inokurudzirwa uye nzvimbo zhinji dzinongosvikika chete nemota dze4x4 dzine mavhiri akakwirira.
text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Chengeta mumusoro uchironga kuti kunyangwe Chamhembe cheAfrica chisina mhirizhonga hadzisi dzese nyika dzakakomberedza dzakadaro.
text_en: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Zvinodiwa zveVhisa zvinosiyana kubva kunyika imwe neimwe zvakare zvinobatwa nekuti unobva kunyika ipi.
text_en: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Nyika yega yega ine mutemo wekuti zvinhu zvakaita sei zvinofanira kunge zviri mumotokari panoitika njodzi.
text_en: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls iguta riri kuchikamu chekumadokero cheZimbabwe, mhiri kwebhodha kubva kuLivingstone, Zambia, uye pedyo neBotswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Dhorobha riri pedyo nemapopoma, uye anokwezva zvikuru, asi iyi nzvimbo yekushanyirwa inozivikanwa inopa vose vanotsvaka kunakidzwa kwakasiyana nevanoona nzvimbo mikana yakawanda yekugara kwengura refu.
text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Mumwaka wekunaya (Mbudzi kusvika muna Kurume), uwandu hwemvura hunenge hwakanyanya uye Mapopoma anenge achivaraidza.
text_en: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Kana ukayambuka bhiriji racho kana kufamba nemunzira dziri pedyo neMapopoma haumbotadzi kunyorova.
text_en: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Asiwo sezvo mvura yacho yakawanda chaizvo, zvinoita kuti usanyatsoona mapopoma acho.
text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Guva raTutankhamum (KV62). KV62 rinogona kunge riri guva rinozivikanwa zvakanyanya pamakuva ari muMupata, iro rakawanikwa naHaward Carter muna1922 uye rinoratidza kuvigwa kwakaitwa mambo wechidiki uyu.
text_en: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Zvichienzaniswa nemamwe makuva emadzimambo, guva raTutankhamum harisi remaoresa zvekuti ringada kutoonekwa sezvo riri diki diki uye risina kumboshongedzwa.
text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Munhu anenge achida kuona umboo hwekukanganiswa kwakaitwa chitunha chakaomeswa chemufi pachaiedzwa kubviswa mubhokisi achabhowekana paachaona kuti musoro chete nemapendekete ndizvo zviri kuoneka.
text_en: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Hupfumi hwakanakisa hweguva racho hauchisiri imomo, asi hwakabviswa kuendeswa kumuseum yeIjipita iri muKairo.
text_en: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Zvingave nani kuti vashanyi vane nguva shoma vashandise nguva yavo kumwewo kunhu.
text_en: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom iri makiromita 12 kumaodzanyema kwakadziva kumadokero kweSiem Reap. Temperi iyi iri pamusoro pegomo yakavakwa nechekunopera kwemakore ekuma800, panguva yaitonga Mambo Yasovarman.
text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Zvakaita temberi yacho zvinosuwisa, uye kuiona uri pamusoro pedziva reTonle Sap zvinoita kuti munhu ade kukwira kuchikomo ichi.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Kana munhu akashanyira nzvimbo iyi anogonawo kubva aita rwendo rwekuenda kurwizi nechikepe.
text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Gwaro rinonzi Angkor Pass rinodiwa kuti upinde mutemberi, saka usakanganwa kuunza pasipoti yako kana uchienda kuTonle Sap.
text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Jerusarema ndiro guta guru reIsrael, kunyangwe dzimwe nyika dzose uye veUnited Nations vasingaricherechedzi seguta guru reIsrael.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Guta rekare kare riri kuJudhiya, rava nemakore nemakore ririko uye rine nhoroorondo refu.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Guta rino idzvene kuzvitendero zvitatu izvi zvekunamata -ChiJudha, chiKristu nechiIslam, iye inoshanda senzimbo yezvemeya, chitendero netsika.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Nekuda kwekukosheswa kweguta racho panyaya dzechitendero, zvikuru sei nzvimbo dzakawanda dzeGuta Rekare, Jerusarema nderimwe remaguta anoshanyirwa chaizvo muIsrael.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Jerusarema inenzvimbo dzezvakaitika kare, nezvekuchera matongo uye nenzvimbo dzetsika, pamwe nezvinesimba uye zvitoro zvepakati zvakazara, macafe nezvitoro zvekudyira.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ecuador inotarisira kuti vagari veCuba vatambire tsamba yekukoka vasati vapinda muEcuador kupfurikidza nenhandare dzengege dzemunyika kana kuti mekupinda namo pamabhodha.
text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Tsamba iyi inofanirwa kuiswa pamutemo negurukota rinoona nezvekunze kwenyika yeEcudore, uye inofanira kutevedzera zvimwe zvinodiwa.
text_en: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Izvi zvinodiwa zvakaitwa kuti pave nekurongeka pakutama kwevanhu pakati penyika idzi mbiri.
text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Zvizvarwa zvekuCuba izvo zvine mvumo yekugara zvachose muUS zvinofanira kushanyira veEmbasi diki yeEcuador kuti vasabatanidzirwe pazviri kudiwa izvi.
text_en: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Pasipoti yako inosungirwa kuva ichisevenza kwemwedzi mitanhatu kupfuura mazuva aunofamba. Tiketi rekuenda nekudzoka rinodiwa kuratidza hurefu hwenguva yauchagara.
text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Kushanya kunochipa kana vanhu vakashanya vari zvikwata, saka kana uri wega kana kuti uine shamwari imwe chete, edzai kubatana nevamwe vanhu moumba chikwata chevanhu vana kana vatanhatu kuti muderedze mutengo unobhadhara munhu mumwe chete.
text_en: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Zvisinei, izvi hazvifaniri kukushamisa kana kukunetsa, nekuti kazhinji vashanyi vanotenderedzwa tenderedzwa kuti vazadze mota.
text_en: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Zvinoita sekuti kunyengedza vanhu kuti vanofanira kuripa mazakwatira emari.
text_en: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Nechekumusoro kwekumaodzanyemba kweMachu Picchu pane gomo rakakwirira, kazhinji rinoshandiswa kumashure kwemifananidzo yakawanda yematongo.
text_en: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Zvinoonekwa sezvinotyisa uchiona nepasi, zvakare pamukwidza uye yakaoma kukwira, asi vanhu vane hutano huri pakati nepakati vanofanirwa kupedza mumaminitsi anoita 45.
text_en: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Pane matombo anoiswa munzira yacho uye munzvimbo dzinotsvedza munoiswa masimbi ekuti vanhu vanofamba vakabata.
text_en: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Ndekudaro, tarisira kutadza kunyatsofema, uye ngwarira makadzikadzika, kunyanya kana makanyorova, sezvo munogona kuitika njodzi.
text_en: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Pane kapako kadiki kari pedyo nekumusoro kanofanirwa kupfuurwa nako, kakaderera zvikuru uye kakamanikana zvikuru.
text_en: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Kuona nzvimbo nemhuka dzesango dzepaGalapagos kunonyanyoitika zvakanaka nechikepe, sekuita kwazvakaitwa naCharles Darwin muna 1835.
text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Zvikepe zvinodarika 60 zvinofamba pamvura dzeGalapagos - dzine hukuru hwakasiyana siyana kubva pakutakura vanhu 8 kusvika 100.
text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Vanhu vazhinji vanobata nzvimbo dzavo pachine nguva (sezvo zvikapo zvinowanzozara munguva yemwaka wakakwirira).
text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Cherechedza kuti mutariri wauri kunyoresa naye ndimazvikokota weGalapagos anoziva zvakakwana rwezvikepe zvemhando dzose dzose.
text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Izvi zvinoita kuti zvido zvako chaizvo kana kuti zvipingamupinyi zvifambirane nengarava inonyatsoenderana navo.
text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Vanhu vekuSpain vasati vasvika makore ekuma1500, kuchamhembe kweChile kwaitongwa neInca asiwo zvizvarwa zvemo maAraucania (Mapuche), zvaigara nechepakati uye nechekumaodzanyemba kweChile.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Vanhu vechiMapuche ndivo boka revanhu vemuAmerica rakazvimirira rekupedzisira risina kumedzwa kuti ribatane neutongi hwaitaura chiSpanish kutozosvikira Chile yawana kuzvitonga kuzere.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Kunyangwe Chile yakawana kuzvitonga kuzere muna 1810 (panguva yairwiwa hondo dzaNapoleon dzakasiya idzo yakasiyaSpain isina hurumende inoshanda kwemakore akati kuti), yakazonyatsokunda Spain muna 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Dominican Republic (MuchiSpanish: Republica Dominicana) inyika yekuCaribbean inobata chidumbu chepakati chechitsuwa chekumabvazuva cheHispaniola, icho chachinogovana ne Haiti.
text_en: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Kunze kwemahombekombe ane jecha uye makomo, nyika iyi ndiyo ine guta rekare kupfuura mamwe ese muEurope riri munyika dzeAmerica, uye rava chikamu cheSanto Domingo.
text_en: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Chitsuwa chakagarwa nevaTainos nevaKaribhe pakutanga. VaKaribhe vaitaura mutauro wevaArawak avo vaive vasvika nechekuma10,000 BCE.
text_en: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Makore mashoma mushure mekuuye kwevaongorori vekuEurope, uwandu hwevanhu verudzi rwechiTaino hwakaderedzwa chaizvo nevapambepfumi vekuSpain.
text_en: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Kutsamira panaFray Bartolome de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) pakati pa1492 na1498 vakundi vekuSpain vakauraya vaTainos vanoda kusvika 100,000.
text_en: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Nzvimbo yeJardín de la Unión. Pakavakwa senzvimbo yakavhurika kuitira munhu akatendeuka mugore rezana rechi17, naizvozvo Tembere ye San Diego ndicho chega chivakwa chasara chakamira.
text_en: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Ndiyo plaza yava kunyanya kushandiswa, uye rinenge richingova bara wamhanya siku nesikati.
text_en: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Kune maresitorendi akati wandeyi akatenderedza gadheni, uye nguva dzemasikati nemanheru kune makonzati anopihwa pachena kubva pakati pechimba chekutandarira.
text_en: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Pamidhuri miviri yakaparadzana nemasendimita 69 chete ndipo panobvira ngano yerudo yekare.
text_en: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Kungopa vamwe vana mashereni mashoma kunoita kuti vakuudze zvakawanda nezvenzvimbo yacho.
text_en: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Vanhu vanowanzoshanyira Bowen Island kwezuva rimwe chete kana kuti pakupera kwevhiki vachinokwasva igwa mumvura, kukwira makomo, kutenga muzvitoro, kunodya mumaresitorendi, nezvimwe zvakawanda.
text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Iyi nharaunda yepamutemo iri muHowe Sound kure zvishoma neVancouver, uye inosvikika nyore nekushandisa mabhoti anoita zvekutakura vanhu achifamba zvakarongwa anosimuka kubva kuGranville Island iri muguta reVancouver.
text_en: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Kune vanofarira zvekutandara vari panze, hamufaniri kutomborega kufamba nemunonzi muSea to Sky nekuti munonakidza.
text_en: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (iyo iri kure neVancouver nechinhambwe chekuti munhu anotyaira kweawa nehafu) inodhura asi inozivikanwa chaizvo nemhaka yemakwikwi e2010 Winter Olympics.
text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Munguva yechando, chimboedza kunakidzwa nemutambo wekutsvedza muchando kuAmerica, uye munguva yezhizha imboendza kuchovha bhasikoro munzvimbo dzine makomo.
text_en: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Mapepa emvumo anofanira kuchengetwa pachiine nguva. Unofanira kuve nepepa remvumo kuti urare husiku humwe kuSirena.
text_en: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena ndicho chiteshi choga chinopa nzvimbo yekurara nezvekudya zvinopisa pamusoro pepekuisa musasa. La Leona, San Pedrillo, ne Los Pato vanopa pekuisa musasa asi pasina chikafu.
text_en: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Zvinogoneka kuwana tendero yekupinda kupaki kutobva kuRanger Station muPuerto Jiménez, asi havatambire makadhi ekubhanga.
text_en: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: VePark Service (MINAE) havapi mapemiti ukupaka pachiine mwedzi mumwe mberi kwekutarisira kusvika.
text_en: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol inoita zvekubhukisa vanhu nemutengo we$30, kana kuti $10 pakubvumirwa kupinda kwezuva rimwe; zvakawanda papeji yavo yeCorcovado.
text_en: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Zvitsuwi zveCook inyika yezvitsuwi ine wirirano yakasununguka neNew Zealand, zvichiwanikwa kuPolynesia, pakati pegungwa reSouth Pacific.
text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Mubatanidzwa une zvitsuwi 15 zvakapararira pamusoro pemamiriyoni 2.2 emakm2 egungwa.
text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Sezvo zvitsuwa izvi zviine nguva yakafanana neyekuHawaii, zvinowanzotaurwa kuti zvine ushamwari neHawaii.
text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Kunyange yakadukupa, inotondedza nezvevamwe vashanyi vechikuru nezveHawaii isati yazvimirira senyika isati yava nemahotera makuru evashanyi neimwewo budiriro.
text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Zvitsuwa zveCook Islands hazvina maguta asi kune zvitsuwa 15. Zvikuru zvacho ndezvinoti Rarotonga neAitutaki.
text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Munyika dzakabudirira nhasi, kupa mubhedha wemhando yepamusoro uye zvekudya zvemangwanani kwakavandudzwa kuitwa senzira yeunyanzvi.
text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Nechepamusoro pekupedzisira, B&Bs zviri pachena kuti vanokwikwidzana pazvinhu zviviri zvinokosha: pekurara uye zvekudya zvemakuseni.
text_en: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Nekudaro, kunzvimbo dzakanaka kudai, munhu anogona kuwana pekurarira panotefetera, pamwe gumbeze rakarukwa nemaoko kana mubhedha wekare kare.
text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Kudya kwemangwanani kunogona kusanganisira zvinoka zvemwaka iwoyo zvemunharaunda kana zvakakosha zvabikwa nemushumiri.
text_en: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Nzvimbo yacho inogona kunge chiri chivako chekare chakanyatsoiswa zvinhu zvakanaka, pachivanze paine tsangadzi uye dziva rekushambira.
text_en: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Zvinonakidza kufamba nemota yako uchienda kunzvimbo iri kure.
text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Zvichisiyana nemotokari hombe, unofanira kunge uchitoziva kutyaira motokari yako uye uchiziva zvainokwanisa kuita nezvaisingakwanisi.
text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Kumisikidza tende chero rakakura sei panzvimbo yevaridzi kana mutaundi kunokwanisa kudaidza maziso akawanda wanda zvinova zvisingadiwe.
text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Tingangoti kushandisa motokari yako kuenda parwendo inzira yakanaka yekufamba nemugwagwa, asi kashoma kuti munhu anange "kumusasa" paanenge ari parwendo.
text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Unogona kushanya uchinoona nzvimbo uchigara mumota kana uine mota hombe yakadai sekombi, SUV, kana kuti mota diki inenge iine zvigaro zvinopeteka.
text_en: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Mamwe mahotera ane nhaka kubva kunguva yekare yegoridhe yezvitima zvaifambiswa nemarasha nezvikepe zvepanyanza; hondo yepiri yepasi rose isati yarwiwa, mumakore emazana echi19 kana kutanga kweechi20.
text_en: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Mumahotera aya ndimo maienda shoroma nevanhu vakakurumbira mazuva iwayo, uye kakawanda kacho vaidya zvemberi imomo uye vachiva neusiku hwakanaka.
text_en: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Zvivako izvi zvine midziyo yekare kare, uye zvivako izvi zvinonyatsoratidza runako rwezvinhu zvekare kare.
text_en: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Kunyange zvazvo mahotera aya asiri ehurumende, dzimwe nguva anogamuchira vatungamiriri venyika nevamwewo vanhu vanoremekedzwa.
text_en: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Mufambi ane mari yakawandisisa anogona kufunga kubhururuka achitenderera pasi rose, zvakapatsanurwa nekugara mumahotera aya mazhinji.
text_en: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Mubatanidzwa wekugamuchira vashanyi isangano rinobatanidza vafambi nevanhu vemuno vemunharaunda yemumaguta avari kunoshanyira.
text_en: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Kubatana nemanetwork emhando iyi kunowanzoitwa nekungonyora fomu paindaneti; kunyange zvazvo mamwe manetwork achida kuzoziva zvimwe zvinhu kuti vanyatsoziva nezvako.
text_en: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Dorongodzo yevanogamuchira vanhu varipo inopihwa kungave zvakadhindwa uye / kana paindaneti, dzimwe nguva nezvapupu uye ongororo dzakaitwa nevamwe vafambi.
text_en: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing yakatangwa mumwedzi waNdira 2004 pashure pekunge nyanzvi yezvemakombiyuta inonzi Casey Fenton yawana ndege yakachipa kuenda kuIceland asi yakanga isina pekuzogara.
text_en: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Akatumira tsamba kuvadzidzi vepayunivhesiti yemo uye vakawanda chaizvo vaida kumupa pekugara mahara.
text_en: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Mahositeri anowanzogara vechidiki vari mumakore ekuma20, asiwo vanhu vakura vanenge vashanya vanokwanisa kugarawo ikoko.
text_en: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Mhuri dzine vana hadziwanzoonekwa, asi mamwe mahositeri anotendera vana mumakamuri akavanzika.
text_en: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Guta reBeijing riri kuChina ndiro richaitirwa makwikwi eOlympic Winter Games muna 2022, izvo zvichaita kuti rive ndiro guta rekutanga kuitirwa mutambo wemwaka wekupisa newechando.
text_en: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing ndiyo ichaitirwa mutambo wekutanga newekupedzisira wekukumikidza mitambo iyi inotambirwa muchando.
text_en: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Zvimwe zviitiko zvemutambo wekutsvedza muchando zvichaitirwa kuTaizicheng muZhangjiakou, anenge makiromita 220 kana kuti mamaira 140 kubva kuBeijing.
text_en: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Matemberi mazhinji anoita Mutambo wepagore negore kutanga kunoperera mwedzi waMbudzi kusvika pakati pemwedzi waChivabvu, unosiyana zvichifambirana nekarenda yepatemberi imwe neimwe.
text_en: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Mitambo yakawanda inowanzopembererwa panopembererwa zuva rekukumikidzwa kwetemberi kana kuti pashure pekupemberera zuva rekuberekwa ramwari wavo kana kuti panoitwa chimwe chinhu chikuru patemberi.
text_en: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Mitambo yematemberi eKerala inovaraidza kuona zvikuru, uyezve nekufora kwenguva dzose kwenzou dzakashongedzwa, vezviridzwa vetembere nedzimwe mhemberero.
text_en: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Feya Yepasi Rese (unowanzonzi World Expositon, kana kungoti Expo) mutambo mukuru wepasi rose wehumhizha nesainzi.
text_en: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Nyika dzaiva nezviratidzwa zvairatidza unyanzvi hwekudhirowa pamwe nehwedzidzo munzvimbo dzakawanda dzichiratidza zvinhu zviri kuitika pasi rese kana kuti tsika nenhoroondo dzavo.
text_en: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: International Horticultural Expositions zviitiko zvakarongeka zvekuratidza maruva, magadheni emiti nemaruva uye chero chinhu chine chekuita nemiti.
text_en: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Kunyange zvazvo pakutaura zvingaitika gore negore (chero benzi zviri munyika dzakasiyana), chaizvoizvo haizvitiki saizvozvo.
text_en: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Zviitiko izvi zvinowanzoita mwedzi mitatu kusvika kumitanhatu, uye zvinoitirwa panzvimbo dzisiri pasi pemahekita 50.
text_en: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Kune mafomati akawanda emafirimu aishandiswa mumakore akawanda apfuura. Firimu yakajairika ye35 mm (36 ne 24 mm negetivhi) ndiyo inonyanyozivikanwa.
text_en: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Unogona kuisa imwe zviri nyore kana yapera, uye inobudisa mifananidzo yakada kuenderana neDSLR yemazuva ano.
text_en: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Mamwe makamera emafirimu epakati anoshandisa fomati ye6 ne6 cm fomati, kunyanyisa negative 56 ne56 mm.
text_en: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Izvi zvinopa kukwenenzvera kwekanokwana kana kakapetwa kupfuura makumi matatu nemashanu emamirimita negative (zviuru zvitatu nezana nemakumi matatu netanhatu emamirimita squre zvichikwikwidzana ne mazana masere nemakumi matanhatu nezvina).
text_en: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Mufananidzo wemhuka dzemusango ndeumwe unonetsa kune anotora mipikicha, unotoda musanganiswa werombo rakanaka, kutora nguva yekunyatsomirira, ruzivo uye zvishandiso zvakanaka.
text_en: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Kutora mifinanidzo yemumasango ibasa rinowanzo kutorwa serisina basa, asi sekutora mifananidzo kazhinji, mufananidzo wakakosha sechiuru chemazwi.
text_en: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Kutora mhuka dzemusango mifananidzo kunowanzoda kamera inokwanisa kuona zviri kure kure yozviudza padhuze dhuze, asiwo kutora boka reshiri kana kuti tumwe tupuka tudiki kunodawo dzimwe mhando dzemakamera.
text_en: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Mhuka dzakawanda dzinobva kune dzimwe nyika hadzisi nyore kuwana, uye mapaki ane mitemo yavanoshandisa kana munhu achida kutora mapikicha emhuka idzi kuti azoashandisa pane zvebhizinesi.
text_en: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Mhuka dzemusango dzinogona kunge dzichinyara kana kuti dziine hasha. Kunze kunogona kunge kuine chando, kuchipisa kana kuti kwakangoti kwindi.
text_en: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Pasi rese pane mitauro yakasiyanasiyana inopfuura 5 000, kusanganisira inopfuura makumi maviri inotaurwa nevanhu mamiriyoni 50 kana kupfuura.
text_en: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Mashoko akanyorwa kakawanda anoita nyore kunzwisisa pane mashoko akataurwa. Izvi zvinoitika zvakanyanya kumakero, ayo anowanzonetsa kuataura zvinonzwisisika.
text_en: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Nyika zhinji dzinogona chirungu zvakanaka, uye kunyangwe mune dzimwe unogona kutarisira ruzivo rushoma -zvikuru kuanhu vemazera echidiki.
text_en: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Chimbofunga, kana uchida, muMancunian, muBostonian, muJamaican nemuSydneysider, vakagara vakakomberedza tafura vachidya zvemanheru paresitorendi muToronto.
text_en: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Ivo vari kunyorerana ivo pachaya nenyaya dzekumamisha avo, zvinoburitswa nematauriro avo aripachena uye kutaura kwavo pachena.
text_en: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Kutenga chikafu muzvitoro kazhinji ndiyo nzira iri nyore yekuwana zvekudya. Pasina mukana wekubika, sarudzo dzekuwana chikafu chakabikwa kare ishoma.
text_en: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Masupamaketi ari kuwedzera kuisa mhando dzakasiyana siyana dzezvekudya zvakagadzirwa nechekare. Mamwe acho anotori nemichina yekudziisa zvekudya kana dzimwe nzira dzekudziisa zvekudya.
text_en: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Mune dzimwe nyika kana mhando dzezvitoro kune resitorendi imwechete zvayo, kazhinji inenge isina kukoshesha zvepamusoro uye ine mitengo yakaderera.
text_en: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Gadzira uye utakure makopi egwaro rako uyezve famba nenhamba dzeavo vakakuitira inishuwarenzi.
text_en: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Vanofanira kuratidza e-mail yemunhu weinishuwarenzi uye nhamba dzake dzefoni kuti vapiwe mazano kana kuti mvumo uye kuti vakumbire kudzorerwa zvinhu zvavanofunga kuti vanofanira kudzorerwa.
text_en: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Iva neimwe kopi mumabhegi ako uye pakombiyuta (zvitumire tsamba ine dhokumendi, kana kuchengetera pa "cloud").
text_en: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Kana uchifamba nelaptop kana tablet, isa imwe kopi mumemory card (yekuti unokwanisa kuzoriona kunyange uri pasina indaneti).
text_en: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Zvakare ipa gwaro remutemo/kana makopi kune vaunofamba navo nehama kana shamwari dziri kumusha dzinoda kubatsira.
text_en: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Mhuka inonzi Moose (iyo inonziwo elk) haina hasha, asi inozvidzivirira kana ikafunga kuti iri kuda kurwiswa.
text_en: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Vanhu panofunga kuti chidzvororo hachikuvadzi, vanogona kutoenda padhuze nacho vasingazive kuti vari kuzvipinza muna taisireva.
text_en: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Inwa zvinhu zvinodhaka uchiziva pekugumira. Doro rinokanganisa vanhu, saka zvakakosha kuti uzive paunofanira kugumira.
text_en: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Kunwa doro zvakanyanya kunogona kukuvadza munhu zvekuti anogona kukuvadzwa chiropa, anogona kuita bofu kana kutofa chaiko. Dambudziko racho rinozotonyanya kuvapo kana munhu achinwa doro riri kugadzirwa zvisiri pamutemo.
text_en: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Doro risingabvumirwe rinogona kuva nezvinhu zvinokuvadza zvinosanganisira methanol, iyo inogona kuita kuti munhu ave bofu kana kufa nyangwe yapiwa muzvikamu zvidiki.
text_en: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Magirazi emaziso anogona kuva nemutengo wakaderera kune imwe nyika, kunyanya kunyika dzinobhadhara vashandi mari shoma uko mari inoshandiswa pakubhadhara vashandi iri shoma.
text_en: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Funga kuongororwa maziso uchiri kumba, kunyanya kana inishuwarenzi ichibhadhara, uye kuunza pepa remushonga kuti utengenge kumwe kunhu.
text_en: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Mafuremu emazita emhando yepamusoro anowanikwa munzvimbo dzakadai anogona kuita zvinhu zviviri zvinonetsa; mamwe anogona kunge asina kunyatsoti tsvikiti, uye chaiwo chaiwo anogona kunge achidhura kupfuura ekumusha.
text_en: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kofi ndeimwe yezvinhu zvinotengeswa zvakanyanya pasi rese, pamwe unogona kuwana mhando zhinji dzekofi kwaunogara.
text_en: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Kunyange zvakadaro, kune nzira dzakawanda dzekumwa kofi kupota pasi rese dzakakosha kumbodziravidza.
text_en: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Canyoning kana kuti canyoneering kupinda mukati megomba rinenge rakacherwa nemvura, gomba racho rinogona kunge risina mvura kana kuti riinayo.
text_en: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Canyoning inosanganisira kuita zvese, kushambira, kukwira, kusvetuka, asi hazvimbodi kudzidzira kwakanyanya kuita zvinhu izvi uye zvakaita muviri wemunhu hazvinyanyi hazvo kukosha (kana tichienzanisa nekukwira nzvimbo dzine matombo, kusvetukira mumvura uchibva pakakwirira, kutsvedza muchando, nezvimwewo).
text_en: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Kuita hiking mutambo unoitirwa panzwe unosanganisira kufamba mumasango, kazhinji pachitevedzerwa nzira dzekufamba.
text_en: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Kukwira makomo masikati kunoitwa panzendo dziri pasi pemaira kana kuti mufambo unokwanisa kupedzwa nezuva rimwe.
text_en: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Kana munhu achida kunokwira makomo kwezuva rimwe chete haana zvakawanda zvaanofanira kugadzirira, uye chero munhu ane utano hwakanaka anokwanisa kunozviita.
text_en: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Mhuri dzine vana vadiki dzinoda nguva yakawanda yekugadzirira, asi zuva rimwechete rekuva panze rinokwanisika nyore kunyangwe nevacheche uye vana vasati vatanga chikoro.
text_en: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Pasi rese pane masangano angasvika 200 anoita kuti vanhu vaone nzvimbo dzakasiyana-siyana dzakanaka vachimhanya. Akawanda acho anoshanda akazvimiririra.
text_en: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Mutevedzeri wemuridzi weGlobal Running Tours, Go Running Tours anoona nezvevanhu vakawanda vanobatsira vamwe kuona nzvimbo dzinoyevedza mumakondinendi mana.
text_en: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Running Tours Barcelona yekuBarcelona uye Running Copenhagen yekuCopenhagen ndidzo dzakatanga nazvo uye dzakakurumidza kujoinwa neRunning Tours Prague yekuPrague nedzimwewo.
text_en: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Kune zvinhu zvizhinji zvaunofanira kufunga nezvazvo usati washanya uye kana uri kushanya.
text_en: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Paunovhakacha, iva netarisiro yekuti zvinhu zvisafanane "nekumusha". Maitiro, mitemo, zvekudya, huwandu wevafambi nezvinofamba, pekugara, zviyero, mutauro nezvimwe zvakangodaro, zvichatosiyana nekwaunobva.
text_en: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Ichi chinhu chaunofanira kugara uchifunga mupfungwa, kuitira kuti udzivirire kuzoora moyo kana pamwe kusafarira nzira dzemuno dzekuita zvinhu.
text_en: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Makambani anoita zvekufamba aivapo kubva mugore rezana rechi19. Mutaririri wezvekufamba kazhinji isarudzo yakanaka parwendo sezvo vachiwedzeredza pamusoro pezvakambosangana nemufambi maringe nezvisikwa, tsika, mutauro kana zvenyika dzisina kunyatsobudirira.
text_en: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Kunyangwe masangano mazhinji arikuda kutora zvibato zvizhinji, masangano mazhinji anehunyanzvi pane mamwe marudzi ekufamba nawo, mitengo rakaterera uye nzvimbo dzekuenda.
text_en: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Zvinokwanisa kuita nani kupa basa kumumiririri anoita zvenyoresa nzendo dzakafanana nerwendo rwako.
text_en: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Ongorora kuti ndedzipi nzendo dziri kushambadzwa nemunhu wacho, pangava paindaneti kana kuti pamahwindo echitoro.
text_en: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Kana uchida kutenderera uchiona nyika, uine chinangwa chaicho, uchida kungovhakacha kana kuti wazviudza kuti uri kuda kumbozviita, pane nzira dzakawanda dzekuti uzviite nenzira yakachipa.
text_en: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Kazhinji, zvinopinda muzvikwata zviviri: Zvichida shanda paunenge uri parwendo kana kuti edza kuderedza mari yaunoshandisa. Chinyorwa ichi chiri kutarira pfungwa yekugumisira.
text_en: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Kune vaya vangada kubayira utefetefe, nguva uye fungidziro yekuderedza mari yekushandisa kusvika pedyo nekusatombobhadhara chinhu, ona bhajeti yemari shomanana pakushanya.
text_en: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Kurudziro iripo ndeyekuti vanhu vanenge vachishanya havafaniri kuba, kupinda munzvimbo dzavasingabvumirwi, kutengesa zvinhu zvisingabvumirwi nemutemo, kana kuti kutsotsa vamwe vanhu.
